title: Jilted, Made a Concubine, and Swapped Bodies with the Prince of Chu
author: Wuyue You
synopsis:
On the day of her grand wedding, Xue Wanyao's bridal sedan chair was struck by lightning and tumbled into the water. Passing by, the young Prince of Chu noticed the bride falling into the water with no one to save her, so he jumped in and rescued her. 

When Xue Wanyao arrived at the gates of the Wuding Marquis Residence in her soaked wedding dress, she unexpectedly heard orders for the bridal sedan chair to turn back. Her prospective mother-in-law, the Marchioness of Wuding, had always valued her own pristine reputation; disgusted that Xue Wanyao had fallen into the water and been saved by another man, thus losing her reputation, she demanded to call off the marriage in public. 

Having no other choice, Xue Wanyao had to return to the Xue family, only to be driven out by her family, who equally valued their pristine reputation, on the grounds that she had lost hers. 

Two paths lay before Xue Wanyao: one was to commit suicide to preserve her reputation, and the other was to go to a Taoist temple to become a nun.

chapters.title: Offering Herself in Gratitude
chapters.content:
"The bride has fallen into the water!"

"How on earth did the bride fall into the water?"

"The bridal sedan chair was struck by lightning! The bride actually fell right out of it and straight into the river."

On the busiest main street in Shengjing City, a large crowd of onlookers had gathered.

A clear, sharp male voice rang out: "The bride has fallen into the water, and you're all just standing there stunned? Why aren't you saving her immediately?"

A youth of about seventeen on the bank shouted anxiously when he saw the onlookers just watching the excitement without lending a hand.

Because of her heavy golden head ornaments, the bride in the water was struggling desperately, her life hanging by a thread.

Seeing that everyone around was merely watching the spectacle and no one was helping, the youth simply plunged straight into the river.

"Plop!"

With a splash, the water’s surface rippled in circles as the youth entered.

Gu Zhuo hurriedly wrapped his arms around the frantically struggling bride. Choking on several mouthfuls of water, Xue Wanyao reached out and tightly grasped the waist of the youth in front of her, terrified that he might not save her.

The spring river water in February still carried a bone-chilling cold, but the warmth radiating from the youth made Xue Wanyao feel much better.

Gu Zhuo swam to the bank and helped Xue Wanyao over to the matchmaker, signaling her to lend a hand in supporting the bride.

Once ashore, Xue Wanyao knew she must look a complete mess. Coughing several times, she looked at the handsome, soaking-wet youth who had come up beside her and said, "May I ask the young master’s honorable surname and given name? I shall surely repay this great grace of saving my life today."

The youth tossed his head. "This Prince does not change his name when he walks, nor does he hide it when he sits: I am Gu Zhuo, the Prince of Chu."

Xue Wanyao looked curiously at the youth before her. So he was the famous Gu Zhuo of Shengjing City.

Xue Wanyao knelt down. "I have no way to repay this life-saving grace. In the next life, I will surely act as an ox or a horse to reward your Highness."

Gu Zhuo frowned slightly. "Your Highness? Judging by your age, you aren't necessarily younger than me, yet you call me 'Your Highness'? I shouldn't have saved you."

"Your Highness," Xue Wanyao corrected herself repeatedly, "another day I will surely act as an ox or a horse to repay the Prince of Chu."

After kneeling and kowtowing, Xue Wanyao stood up and said to the matchmaker, "Let's get into the bridal sedan chair; we mustn't miss the auspicious hour."

The matchmaker looked at the disheveled Xue Wanyao and said, "Second Young Miss, your entire outfit is soaked through with water..."

Xue Wanyao replied, "It's no matter. In any case, my husband is too ill to hold the wedding ceremony. Later, we can just have the sedan chair carried directly into the bridal chamber, and two roosters can stand in for the ceremony."

The matchmaker said, "That works too."

Gu Zhuo walked over to the Heir of the Wuding Marquis Residence, who was dressed in a red robe, and said, "Xu Sheng, I never expected the groom to be you. You stood there watching your bride fall into the water and didn't go to save her?"

Xu Sheng, the Heir of the Wuding Marquis Residence, replied, "I am not today's groom; the groom is my eldest brother. A late spring cold hit these past two days, and my eldest brother's asthma flared up again. He couldn't leave his sickbed to welcome the bride and perform the ceremony, so I came to welcome the bride in his stead..."

Gu Zhuo asked curiously, "Even so, she is still your sister-in-law. How could you just stand by and watch her die?"

The Marquis Heir looked at the naive young Prince of Chu, at a loss for how to explain that the person who fell into the water was his eldest sister-in-law, and as her brother-in-law, how could he possibly jump into the water to hold and embrace her?

Xu Sheng merely smiled. "Your Highness, the auspicious hour is almost upon us. We must return to the Marquis Manor first."

"Who are you calling young?" Gu Zhuo let out a light huff. "I'm coming to your Marquis Manor to share a cup of wedding wine too. Since I saved the Xu family's new daughter-in-law, I can be considered a great benefactor to your manor."

The Wuding Marquis Residence was not far away; it took barely a quarter of an hour to arrive.

However, when the bridal sedan chair arrived, the gates of the Wuding Marquis Residence were tightly shut. Only the Marchioness of Wuding stood at the entrance and declared, "Please turn the sedan chair back. The Wuding Marquis Residence cannot take Miss Xue as a wife."

Sitting inside the bridal sedan chair and continually wiping her hair with a handkerchief in an attempt to make herself more comfortable, Xue Wanyao froze upon hearing these words, her brow furrowing involuntarily.

Xue Wanyao lifted the curtain of the sedan chair, slowly stepped out, and said, "Marchioness, I wonder why the Marquis Manor suddenly wants to break off the engagement at this moment?"

Lifting her chin, the Marchioness of Wuding assumed a deeply dignified posture and said, "Our Wuding Marquis Residence is a family of scholarly repute, always valuing a pristine name. But you fell into the water and were saved by another man, embracing him; you have already lost your good reputation."

"Since you, the Second Young Miss of the Xue family, have lost this reputation, you are not worthy to be a wife of the Xu family!"

Xue Wanyao was still wearing her soaked-through wedding gown, and at that moment, she felt a bone-chilling cold straight to her heart.

"What family of scholarly repute?" Gu Zhuo emerged from the crowd and said, "Not rescuing a drowning sister-in-law makes one no different from a wild beast. Men and women not touching hands when passing items is the ritual, but using one's hand to rescue a drowning sister-in-law is an act of expediency. Your Xu family stood by and watched someone die, yet you still dare to speak of a pristine reputation?"

The Marchioness of Wuding said, "Prince of Chu, you yourself said it is an act of expediency, but what everyone just saw was you holding and embracing the Second Miss Xue as you brought her ashore. The new bride of our Wuding Marquis Residence cannot be a woman who has embraced another man. Miss Xue, please return."

Utterly helpless, Xue Wanyao walked up to her uncle and said, "Uncle... I can only return to my maiden home."

Her paternal uncle, who had come to escort her to the wedding, frowned slightly and immediately sent someone back to the manor to report the news.

Gu Zhuo stepped forward and asked, "Your uncle is here? Why didn't your uncle jump into the water to save you just now?"

Looking at his own legs, Xue's uncle said, "My legs and feet are inconvenient; it was not suitable for me to enter the water to save the Second Young Miss."

Xue Wanyao got back into the bridal sedan chair and instructed the bearers to carry her back to the Xue residence.

When the sedan chair reached the Xue residence, Xue Wanyao had her dowry maid give the bearers some silver, intending to return to her room as quickly as possible to change her clothes.

However, just as she reached the side door, she saw her stepmother, the mistress of the Xue family, emerging with a group of matrons.

Glancing at Xue Wanyao, the Xue Mistress frowned deeply. "You really are mud that can't be plastered onto a wall. You finally managed to latch onto such a splendid match with the Wuding Marquis Residence through your eldest brother-in-law, yet how on earth did you manage to fall out of the bridal chair and into the water? Even being struck by lightning on a clear day is something you managed to encounter!"

"It would have been fine if you had just died in the water, but how could you let another man save you?"

"You're going to ruin the good reputation of the Xue family's daughters completely!"

Frowning, the Xue Mistress continued, "Our Xue family is also a household that cares about its face. Since you are already a married daughter who has met with such a calamity, only two paths lie before you now: either die to prove your innocence and be considered a martyr, or become a nun by taking tonsure at a Taoist temple. As for the Xue family, you can no longer return here."

Lowering her head, Xue Wanyao whispered, "Mother..."

The Xue Mistress said, "Don't blame your mother for being ruthless. You've always been a sensible child, but the marriage prospects of your third and fourth sisters cannot be implicated by you. If you must blame someone, blame your own bad luck."

With that, the Xue Mistress led the group of matrons back inside.

Limping, Xue's uncle walked up to Xue Wanyao and said, "Wanyao, the hair ornaments on your head can still be exchanged for some silver. You can live a fairly decent life in the Taoist temple."

Having said this, Xue's uncle also walked back inside the Xue residence.

Outside the Xue family estate, Xue Wanyao stood completely alone, feeling the bone-chilling gusts of wind blowing through her soaked wedding gown.

As for seeking death, Xue Wanyao was unwilling. To go to a Taoist temple and become a nun, where she would have to do all the dirty and exhausting work, inevitably suffer bullying, and subsist on bran and coarse greens, Xue Wanyao was equally unwilling.

Yet, a third path was not entirely closed off to her.

After making some inquiries, Xue Wanyao headed toward the Prince of Chu's Manor.

The young Prince of Chu who had saved her just now was the son of the reigning Grand Princess and the late Prince of Chu, a prince of a different surname. The Prince of Chu had died in battle ten years ago, and even his remains could not be found.

Pitying his nephew, the Emperor doted on the young Prince of Chu immensely.

Calculating his age, the Prince of Chu was just about at the age to take a wife.

When Xue Wanyao arrived at the gates of the Prince of Chu's Manor, she happened to see Gu Zhuo returning from outside.

Curiously, Gu Zhuo looked at the bride he had rescued just moments before. "You... aren't you the bride I saved a moment ago?"

Xue Wanyao knelt before Gu Zhuo and said, "It is me, Your Highness. I have no way to repay your life-saving grace, and I only wish to offer myself in marriage to you as a concubine to repay the debt of saving my life..."

Gu Zhuo widened his peach-blossom eyes in shock. "You want to repay a life-saving grace, shouldn't you be giving this Prince silver? Is offering yourself in marriage repayment or revenge? This Prince does not want to take a wife yet and be tied down!"

chapters.title: Repaying Kindness with Enmity
chapters.content:
Faced with Gu Zhuo's disdain, Xue Wanyao blushed, but she was simply unwilling to become a nun...

Biting her lower lip until a sharp pain shot through it, she raised her gaze to Gu Zhuo and said, "Your Highness's grace in saving my life is so great that I truly do not know how to repay it. I cannot wait until the next life to act as an ox or a horse for you; I only wish to offer myself to you in this lifetime to repay your life-saving grace..."

Gu Zhuo repeatedly refused, saying, "Offering yourself in marriage isn't repaying kindness; it's repaying kindness with enmity!"

At the main entrance of the Prince of Chu's Manor, a noble matron in her thirties, dressed in brocade and fine silks, crossed the threshold and slowly descended the high steps of the manor.

"You want to offer yourself in marriage to the Prince of Chu?"

"Mother," Gu Zhuo said, looking at the Grand Princess Changping before him.

Xue Wanyao, still kneeling on the ground, hurriedly kowtowed to Grand Princess Changping. "This humble commoner Xue Wanyao pays her respects to Her Highness the Grand Princess."

Grand Princess Changping smiled faintly. "Lift your head."

Xue Wanyao raised her head to look at Grand Princess Changping, who carefully examined Xue Wanyao's face. "Which family's daughter are you? How old are you?"

Xue Wanyao replied, "My late father is Xue Shen, a compiler in the Hanlin Academy. I am the second among my siblings, and I am seventeen this year."

"Seventeen? That makes you the same age as my Zhuo'er. When is your birthday?"

"The ninth day of the fourth month."

Grand Princess Changping smiled. "What a coincidence. My Zhuo'er's birthday is also the ninth day of the fourth month. You were born in the very same year and month, no wonder you share this affinity today. Do you truly wish to offer yourself in marriage to the Prince of Chu?"

Xue Wanyao nodded. "Yes. Today, when the Prince saw me fall into the water, he jumped in and saved my life. I am truly filled with boundless gratitude, yet I am powerless and have nothing to give in return. I can only offer myself to repay the Prince's great grace."

Grand Princess Changping asked, "Even if offering yourself means becoming nothing more than a concubine?"

Xue Wanyao involuntarily clenched her hands. Her own biological mother had been a concubine.

Ever since she was a child, her mother, the concubine, had told her that she must become a proper, legitimate wife in the future and must never lower herself to being a concubine.

After she was engaged to the eldest son of the concubinal line of the Wuding Marquis Residence, her mother had been overjoyed, rejoicing that her daughter would not have to live as a concubine for others as she had, but could instead be the mistress of the house.

Alas, today Xue Wanyao could only fail her mother's expectations.

The moment Xue Wanyao came to the Prince of Chu's Manor, she never imagined her status could allow her to become the Princess of Chu; she had merely hoped to be a secondary consort.

Though both were concubines, the status of a secondary consort was at least slightly higher, but she had not expected to be nothing more than a common concubine.

Nodding, Xue Wanyao said, "Answering Your Highness, as long as I can repay the kindness, I am willing to be the Prince's concubine."

Grand Princess Changping smiled softly. "A sensible child who knows how to repay gratitude. Rise. You shall be a concubine to the Prince of Chu for now. Once you conceive a child, I will secure the title of Secondary Consort of Chu for you."

"Thank you, Grand Princess."

After kowtowing in acknowledgment, Xue Wanyao stood up.

"Mother, I don't want any concubine."

Hearing this, Gu Zhuo frowned and immediately refused.

Grand Princess Changping said coldly, "Zhuo'er, you are nearly eighteen years old. You don't even have a single woman serving by your side right now, how can that do?

You are dead-set against arranged marriages, claiming you are still too young and do not wish to take a wife. Marriage is a lifelong matter, and since you feel you are too young and unwilling to marry, I have let you be. But you must at least take a concubine first.

The Gu family's lineage is already thin, passing down as an only son for three generations, and now you are the solitary seedling left. You should branch out and spread leaves for the Gu family as soon as possible."

"The matter of taking a concubine is thus settled. Wanyao, you will move into the side room of the Prince's Linfeng Courtyard for now. Did you bring any maids with you?"

Xue Wanyao replied in a low voice, "I did not bring any maids."

Before her wedding, her stepmother, the Xue Mistress, fearing that the Wuding Marquis Residence had too many strict rules and that the maids who grew up with her were incapable, had dismissed her two personal maids.

Instead, she had found four new dowry maids for her.

The contracts of sale for those dowry maids were all in her stepmother's hands, so naturally, they had not accompanied her here.

Grand Princess Changping said, "Then tomorrow I will find four maids for you to attend to your needs."

"Thank you, Your Highness the Grand Princess."

Noticing that Xue Wanyao was still wearing her soaked wedding gown, Grand Princess Changping said, "Go inside quickly to bathe and change into a fresh set of clothes, then drink a bowl of ginger soup to ward off the cold."

Xue Wanyao looked at Grand Princess Changping with gratitude. "Thank you, Grand Princess, but... I did not bring any clean clothes with me. I still need to go out to the street and buy a ready-made outfit."

Grand Princess Changping smiled faintly. "There's no need. In my chests, there are quite a few unused garments left idle, all made of fine fabrics. I will have a maid bring them over to you. Jingxin, take Madam Xue to the Linfeng Courtyard to bathe."

"Yes." A matron of about thirty or forty standing beside Grand Princess Changping walked over to Xue Wanyao. "Madam Xue, please follow me."

Hearing the title "Madam Xue," Xue Wanyao felt a myriad of conflicting emotions, yet she was powerless to change it. From the eldest daughter-in-law of the Wuding Marquis Residence to a mere manor concubine...

Still, Xue Wanyao thought, anything was better than going to a Taoist temple to become a nun.

Frowning, Gu Zhuo looked at Grand Princess Changping. "Mother, I have no desire to take a concubine at all."

Grand Princess Changping replied, "Such a fair and lovely young maiden is willing to be your concubine, and you don't want her? Tonight, you must share a room with her."

"Mother!"

Grand Princess Changping said, "There is no negotiating this matter. You must share a room with her tonight. To this day, you stay away from women and have no offspring. How am I to face your father who died an early death when I am a hundred years old? I might as well go find your father right now, so at least I won't have to bear the reproach of failing to raise my son properly..."

Hearing Grand Princess Changping bring up his late father, Gu Zhuo was utterly helpless and could only agree. "Stop nagging, Mother. This child will share a room with the Xue woman today."

Share a room... staying in the same room could also be called sharing a room.

---

Inside the Linfeng Courtyard.

Xue Wanyao followed the maid Jingxin inside. Her gaze swept over the spacious courtyard, which featured a small lotus pond where colorful koi swam, adding a touch of charm to the surroundings.

Upon reaching the bathing room of the Linfeng Courtyard, Jingxin intended to order the maids of the courtyard to come and attend to Xue Wanyao's bath.

Only then did she suddenly remember that there were no maids at all in her young Prince's courtyard.

Instead, Jingxin had to instruct a pageboy to fetch hot water and place it outside the door.

"Madam Xue, there are no maids in this Linfeng Courtyard. If you don't mind, this servant will attend to your bath."

"Sorry to trouble you, Mama Jingxin."

The February air was still quite cold, and having worn a soaked wedding gown all this time, Xue Wanyao had felt chilled to the bone. Once she stepped into the hot spring pool, the warmth gradually dispersed the cold and fatigue.

When Xue Wanyao finished bathing, the Grand Princess's garments had just arrived. It was a lotus-pink cloud-brocade ruqun (jacket and skirt set), which fit Xue Wanyao's figure perfectly.

After drying her hair, Mama Jingxin styled her hair into a bun. "Like a lotus emerging from clear water, Madam Xue is truly a beauty. Today, she will surely make our young Prince break his vow against women."

Hearing Mama Jingxin's words, Xue Wanyao's cheeks flushed red with shyness. As she followed Mama Jingxin into Gu Zhuo's bedchamber, her nervousness became even harder to conceal.

At a glance, Gu Zhuo's bedchamber was clearly the living quarters of a young lord; there was no excessive decoration in the room, save for a jewel-inlaid sword hanging by the bed.

Mama Jingxin helped Xue Wanyao sit down on the edge of Gu Zhuo's bed and said, "Mistress, just wait here for the Prince to arrive. This servant will take her leave first."

"Alright."

After Mama Jingxin stepped out, Xue Wanyao nervously picked at her fingernails, her heart filled with tension.

Outside, the sky grew increasingly dim, and the room darkened as well. Just as Xue Wanyao could barely make out everything in the room anymore, she heard the footsteps of a youth approaching from outside.

"Your Highness, Madam Xue is waiting for you inside..."

chapters.title: Consummation
chapters.content:
"Creak."

The sound of the wooden door being pushed open came, and the light of a lantern flickered in the doorway.

Xue Wanyao wrapped her finger with the silk handkerchief in her hand, the manual of Bihuo (erotic illustrations) that her concubine-mother had shown her yesterday surfacing in her mind. She had originally thought that since the eldest young master of the Marquis of Wuding's estate was gravely ill, it certainly wouldn't be of any use...

Yet she never expected that her husband had turned out to be Gu Zhuo.

Thinking of the manual, Xue Wanyao's face grew increasingly red.

Gu Zhuo stepped forward and lit the candles in the room, filling the bedchamber with light in an instant.

The wooden door was closed from the outside, and the sound of a lock being fastened followed immediately.

Gu Zhuo strode forward to open the door, only to find it already locked from the outside.

The voice of the Prince's estate's senior steward came from the doorway: "Young Prince, Her Highness the Princess has given orders that tonight you must share a room with the concubine, and you are not to step out of this door so much as half a step."

Frowning deeply, Gu Zhuo strode back into the inner chamber. As soon as he entered, he saw a woman dressed in lotus-pink sitting on his bed, her pure, lotus-like face tinged with a flush.

Gu Zhuo said coldly, with a note of vexation: "It was truly a waste of time to save you today. Who would have thought you are such a petty person who repays kindness with enmity!"

Hearing Gu Zhuo's vexed words, Xue Wanyao raised her eyes to look at him. Seeing that the young prince's expression was as dark as pitch, the flush on her face vanished completely.

A petty person...

So what if she was a petty person?

Being a petty person was still better than not being able to survive.

Xue Wanyao was not willing to die an untimely death at seventeen for the sake of so-called reputation.

Nor was she willing to spend the rest of her life in bleakness inside a Taoist temple.

Besides, women in Taoist temples were also bullied by everyone.

Xue Wanyao rose and curtsied, saying, "This humble concubine, Wanyao, pays her respects to my husband. Husband, a night of love is short, let this humble concubine attend to you and rest."

Seeing that Xue Wanyao was about to come forward to untie his sash, Gu Zhuo hastily retreated two steps and said, "Who is your husband? I am certainly not!"

Xue Wanyao said in a low voice, "With my mediocre looks, I am merely a concubine and not worthy of calling the Prince my husband. I beg the Prince's forgiveness."

Xue Wanyao stepped forward, wanting to untie Gu Zhuo's sash, but he retreated another two steps, looking at her as if she were some kind of ferocious beast or flood dragon.

"Don't touch this Prince!"

Meeting Gu Zhuo's look of disgust, Xue Wanyao felt rather deflated.

After all, she was merely a seventeen-year-old maiden who had just been married off. Within a single day, she had been disdained time and time again. It was bad enough that she had become a secondary concubine on what should have been a day of great joy, but to be loathed to this extent...

Xue Wanyao's hand froze in mid-air, tears already welling up in her eyes.

Gu Zhuo said, "Making you a concubine in the Prince's estate was my mother's idea and your own, not mine. Even if you now bear the title of my concubine, this Prince will never touch so much as a hair of yours in the future!"

Xue Wanyao slowly lowered her hand, biting her lower lip tightly as a tear slowly slipped from the corner of her eye.

Gu Zhuo frowned. "What are you crying for? I did a good thing by jumping into the water to save your life, only to be repaid with enmity. I haven't even cried yet, what are you crying for? Hold it back!"

Xue Wanyao could only use her handkerchief to gently wipe away the tears at the corners of her eyes. She did not dare to displease Gu Zhuo, for this place was, after all, her only refuge to establish herself.

Gu Zhuo grabbed a quilt from the bed, threw it to Xue Wanyao, and said, "You sleep on the small couch."

Looking at the silk quilt thrown by Gu Zhuo, Xue Wanyao staggered back two steps, then took the quilt to the small couch and lay down.

The small couch was very hard, and sleeping on it was quite cramped, but having labored all day, simply being able to lie down was already exceedingly good.

Having fallen into the water today, she felt a splitting headache, dizziness, and intense hunger.

After all, she hadn't eaten anything for a whole day.

At this moment, Xue Wanyao just wanted to fall asleep early; perhaps after a sleep, she wouldn't feel hungry anymore.

Perhaps after a sleep, everything today would turn out to be a nightmare, and when she woke up, she would still be the unmarried Second Young Lady of the Xue family...

"Hey, you surnamed Xue, let me warn you, you are not allowed to sneak into bed with me while I'm asleep!"

"If you dare to share a bed with me and ruin my purity, I won't let you off!"

"You surnamed Xue!"

Gu Zhuo shouted for quite a while, but hearing no reply from Xue Wanyao, he walked over to the small couch and saw the woman's sleeping face looking serene, her delicate eyebrows slightly furrowed as if troubled by something.

Looking down at Xue Wanyao from above, Gu Zhuo said, "Hey, you surnamed Xue, you are forbidden to touch me while I'm asleep!"

With that, Gu Zhuo returned to the main bed. Fearing that Xue Wanyao might seize the opportunity of his deep sleep to share the bed with him, he tucked all the bed curtains under the mattress before he dared to fall asleep with peace of mind.

In the dark night sky, because it was early February, there was only a thin sliver of a crescent moon accompanied by a scattering of bright stars.

As the stars shifted in the night sky, a sudden roll of thunder rang out, a loud crash echoing across the entire city of Shengjing.

Startled awake by the thunder, Xue Wanyao realized that she no longer felt hungry, nor did her head ache.

With the sky outside growing faintly bright, Xue Wanyao opened her eyes and frowned slightly as she looked at the unfamiliar bed curtains before her.

Last night, she had clearly slept on the small couch; how had she ended up sleeping on the main bed? Could it be that the young Prince of Chu, Gu Zhuo, had gone back on his word and carried her onto the bed in the middle of the night?

It seemed Gu Zhuo was a gentleman on the surface but actually a lecher at heart...

On the other side, Gu Zhuo, awakened by the thunder, felt a splitting headache and a stomachache from hunger. Wanting to call for his pageboy, he opened his eyes only to find that he was sleeping on the small couch.

Did that woman surnamed Xue really touch him while he was fast asleep?

Feeling rather aggrieved and indignant, Gu Zhuo wondered if his chastity of seventeen years had just been ruined like this.

Why was it that doing a good deed did not bring a good reward?

Gu Zhuo slowly raised his hand, only to find something was amiss. He got up from the small couch and looked down at the lotus-pink ruqun (dress) he was wearing... How could he be wearing a lotus-pink ruqun?

Lifting his hand, he looked at the slender, fair arms before him, and these delicate, calloused-free, jade-like hands painted with nail polish, clearly not his own.

Yet, these were hands he could actually control.

Reaching down, Gu Zhuo did not feel the expected "little Gu Zhuo"...

"Ah!"

While Xue Wanyao was still wondering why she was on the main bed, she heard a woman's scream. She lifted the bed curtains and looked towards the small couch.

There, "Xue Wanyao" was sitting on the small couch with a face full of panic and tension, her gaze directed downward, with both hands placed over her chest...

Xue Wanyao could not help widening her eyes: "Have I met a ghost, or am I still dreaming?"

When Xue Wanyao uttered these words, she was startled. Her voice...

How could her voice be that of a man? And it sounded remarkably like Gu Zhuo's voice.

"Could it be that I have become Gu Zhuo?"

"You, you, you..."

Hearing a man's voice, the person on the small couch, Gu Zhuo, looked up toward the bed. When he saw clearly that the person sitting on the bed was himself, a look of profound shock appeared on his face.

"You're Gu Zhuo? Then who am I?"

Hearing the female voice he was emitting, Gu Zhuo rushed over to the bronze dressing mirror. The reflection clearly showed the delicate and pretty face of a woman.

Gu Zhuo pinched the woman's face hard, and a wave of pain made him frown.

Xue Wanyao said in a low voice, "Uhm, could you not pinch so hard? My skin bruises very easily."

With that, Xue Wanyao also walked over to the bronze mirror and saw the handsome, chiseled face of a youth in the glass. It was just as she had guessed: she had truly turned into Gu Zhuo...

chapters.title: Switching Back
chapters.content:
Xue Wanyao had no idea why she had woken up as Gu Zhuo. She reached out and touched her distinctly angular profile...

"Don't touch me!" A pretty female voice rang out. "You surnamed Xue, you are not allowed to touch me!"

Gu Zhuo glared angrily at the man before him.

Since he had become Xue Wanyao, obviously the person touching his own face right now was Xue Wanyao.

Xue Wanyao's hand paused. She chuckled and said, "I'm not touching you right now. I'm touching myself! I'm using my own hand to touch my face!"

Speaking in a youth's voice still felt somewhat unfamiliar to Xue Wanyao. She reached out to touch her face; the tactile sensation was distinct; she really had become Gu Zhuo.

Gu Zhuo reached out and grabbed the youth's wrist, saying coldly, "What kind of sorcery did you monster use to steal my body? Come, follow me to the Taoist temple and have the Imperial Preceptor switch the two of us back!"

Xue Wanyao looked at the fair, delicate face before her and didn't budge an inch. The woman's body possessed very little strength and couldn't pull her at all.

Gu Zhuo glared at the youth, lifting his eyes. "Hurry up and move..."

"You surnamed Xue, you surely don't want to switch back with this Prince, do you? Do you intend to make this Prince stay as you forever?"

Truth be told, Xue Wanyao harbored no desire to switch back. Being a secondary concubine loathed by the Prince could hardly compare to the carefree life of being the young Prince of Chu!

Frowning deeply, Gu Zhuo said coldly, "I saved your life yesterday! Are you going to repay kindness with enmity again? This body of yours has a headache, a dry throat, is starving, and feeling dizzy; you surely can't be such a petty person!"

Considering that she indeed shouldn't be such a petty person as to steal Gu Zhuo's body and refuse to return it, Xue Wanyao sighed lightly and said, "Your Highness, you must be hungry. After all, I haven't eaten anything since the night before yesterday."

Gu Zhuo asked in confusion, "You haven't eaten anything?"

Xue Wanyao nodded. "Yesterday I was the bride, and I was afraid that if I ate, it would be inconvenient to relieve myself after getting dressed, so I stopped eating from the night before."

Hearing the words "relieve oneself," Gu Zhuo frowned, because he himself wanted to relieve himself right at that moment...

However, he had no idea how a woman relieved herself. Women didn't have that thing; how did they do it?

At the mention of relieving herself, Xue Wanyao's face also flushed red as she said, "Your Highness, may I ask where the latrine in the Linfeng Courtyard is? I need to take care of a small necessity..."

"No!" Gu Zhuo said coldly. "Hold it in! Until my body and yours are switched back, you are not allowed to use the latrine!"

Xue Wanyao coughed and said, "How can I hold this in? If I wet my pants... I am now the young Prince of Chu..."

Gu Zhuo sternly said, "You are the same age as me, try saying 'young' again?"

The moment Gu Zhuo said it, he frowned. Xue Wanyao's voice was too gentle, lacking any hint of dominance.

Seeing that the person before her possessed her own face yet wore such a fierce expression, Xue Wanyao found it rather amusing, as she had never acted so fiercely herself. With a faint smile, she said, "Your Highness, what should I do if I really can't hold it?"

Gu Zhuo replied, "Hold it for now. Hurry up and have my pageboys bring breakfast so I can feel a bit better."

Mindful of her own physical well-being after all, Xue Wanyao walked to the door and found it still locked. She knocked, and someone finally came to open it.

Seeing the two pageboys at the door looking like they had just woken up, Xue Wanyao smiled faintly and said, "Trouble the two brothers to fetch some breakfast. Miss Xue is hungry."

The two pageboys at the door hurriedly responded, "Yes, Your Prince."

They walked a few paces before realizing something was amiss.

"Did the Prince just say 'trouble' to us?"

"Must be that we haven't woken up yet, right?"

"Fool!" Inside the room, Gu Zhuo frowned at Xue Wanyao. "You are the Prince now, and you say 'trouble' to Wang Quan and Fu Gui? And you called them 'brothers'?"

Xue Wanyao coughed lightly. "I didn't consider it thoroughly."

Looking at the maiden's disheveled hair before him, Xue Wanyao coughed again and said, "Your Highness, let me help you put up your hair. Your hair is too messy."

Gu Zhuo sat down before the bronze mirror, letting Xue Wanyao comb the maiden's hair.

Xue Wanyao picked up the wooden comb from the side and began combing the long hair.

When Wang Quan and Fu Gui entered with breakfast, they saw their own young Prince of Chu gently and gracefully combing the long hair of the maiden before him.

Thinking their eyes were playing tricks on them, they rubbed their eyes, only to still see the young Prince of Chu brushing the hair of the newly taken secondary concubine, Concubine Xue, from yesterday.

When Nanny Jingxin entered and witnessed this scene, she smiled knowingly, then left the bedchamber and headed to the Princess Changping's estate next door.

"Princess."

Princess Changping was currently putting on her makeup. Seeing Nanny Jingxin enter, she asked, "Did Zhuo'er consummate his marriage last night?"

Nanny Jingxin smiled. "The marriage was consummated. When this servant went over just now, I saw the Prince brushing Concubine Xue's hair. Having served by Your Highness's side for so long, this servant is seeing our young Prince act so tenderly and meticulously for the very first time."

Princess Changping chuckled lightly. "He has always kept away from women in the past, yet now he's even brushing someone's hair?"

"This servant saw it with her own eyes just now, there's no mistake."

Princess Changping remarked, "Zhuo'er has finally broken his rule regarding women. The matter of finding a Princess Consort for him can now be put on the agenda."

---

Back in Linfeng Courtyard.

Having finished doing her hair, Gu Zhuo sat at the table and ate breakfast. A bowl of piping hot chicken noodle soup went down his stomach, finally relieving his dizziness and easing his stomachache significantly, leaving only the headache.

Gu Zhuo looked at Xue Wanyao and said, "You should sit down and eat some too. You mustn't mistreat my body."

Xue Wanyao bit her lower lip, hesitating as if she wanted to say something...

Gu Zhuo frowned. "Don't make that lip-biting expression using my body!"

Xue Wanyao said, "Your Highness, I won't have breakfast for now. I'm afraid that if I eat, I really won't be able to hold it in and will cause you to lose face. After all... it feels somewhat unbearable right now..."

Frowning deeply, Gu Zhuo wore an expression full of difficulty. "Even if you can't hold it, you must."

Xue Wanyao said, "But it's truly too uncomfortable."

Gu Zhuo said, "Fine then, follow me to the latrine..."

Xue Wanyao followed Gu Zhuo into the latrine.

Gu Zhuo instructed Xue Wanyao, "Close your eyes! You are not allowed to open them!"

Xue Wanyao closed her eyes, but then felt a force at her waist as her sash was being untied. She instantly opened her eyes to see the maiden half-squatting...

The maiden looked up and flushed with anger upon seeing that she had opened her eyes.

"Didn't I tell you to close your eyes? How dare you open them?!"

Xue Wanyao said, "Your Highness, shouldn't you leave?"

Hesitating, Gu Zhuo said, "I'm certainly not going to let you touch... that thing!"

Blushing, Xue Wanyao said, "But your hands right now are my hands. If we can't switch back, so be it, but if we do manage to switch back, I won't even want my own hands anymore."

Gu Zhuo: "..."

Xue Wanyao: "..."

After staring at each other in dismay, Gu Zhuo frowned and left. "Hurry up!"

After Gu Zhuo departed, Xue Wanyao had no choice but to grit her teeth and, blushing furiously... relieve herself.

Once Xue Wanyao came out, Gu Zhuo handed her a basin of water. Only after washing multiple times did she feel clean.

Seeing Xue Wanyao still wiping her hands with the silk handkerchief, Gu Zhuo urged, "Stop dawdling! Hurry to the Taoist temple and find the Imperial Preceptor to switch the two of us back!"

chapters.title: The Will of Heaven Cannot Be Defied
chapters.content:
Xue Wanyao walked out with Gu Zhuo. As they reached the courtyard, Xue Wanyao looked at the bustling, long-striding Gu Zhuo and gave a light cough.

"Concubine Xue, you should walk more like a lady. Don't stride about so roughly."

Gu Zhuo didn't realize for a moment that Concubine Xue was referring to him. He turned his head, looked at the "Prince of Chu" who was walking in dainty steps, and frowned: "You too, where is there any man who walks like this? Take larger steps."

Saying this, seeing that Xue Wanyao was still walking slowly like a lady, Gu Zhuo simply grabbed the youth's hand and led him toward the stables.

Upon reaching the stables, Gu Zhuo walked up to his horse, Mingyue, wanting to untie the reins and mount up.

However, Mingyue seemed not to recognize him anymore and let out a long neigh at him.

Gu Zhuo frowned and pulled Xue Wanyao over. "You ride and take me to the Daoist temple."

"Ah? But I don't know how to ride a horse," Xue Wanyao said in a low voice.

The rules for daughters of the Xue family were extremely strict. By the age of seventeen, Xue Wanyao could count the number of times she had left the manor on one hand, let alone know how to ride a horse.

Gu Zhuo said, "Then we'll take a carriage to the Daoist temple."

"Wang Quan, Fugui, go prepare the carriage."

Gu Zhuo issued instructions to the two pageboys behind him.

The two pageboys looked at each other in blank dismay. Meeting each other's eyes, they wondered why this Concubine Xue, who was now giving them orders, felt so much like their own young prince.

Seeing Wang Quan and Fugui standing still, Gu Zhuo demanded, "My words no longer command you?"

"Please wait a moment, Concubine Xue. We'll go prepare the carriage right away."

Wang Quan and Fugui moved at a remarkably fast pace, soon bringing over a rather luxurious carriage.

Xue Wanyao stepped inside the carriage, sighing with admiration that as expected of one of the most esteemed princes of the current dynasty, this carriage was surprisingly spacious and comfortable.

Even while traveling, there was no jolting to speak of.

---

Back at the Xue manor.

In the courtyard of the Third Concubine.

Xue Yunping, the third young lady of the Xue family, spoke softly to her maid: "Second sister had her engagement broken off yesterday?"

"Indeed. It's the talk of Shengjing City today. Our Second Young Lady's bridal sedan chair was struck by lightning and fell into the water, where she was rescued by a strange man. That's why the Marquis of Wuding's estate sent her back."

Xue Yunping asked, "Has Second Sister returned then? I'll go pay her a visit."

"Why would you go see her?" Third Concubine Hong of the Xue family walked into the room. "Be careful not to invite trouble. Her reputation is completely ruined, and the Xue family has no face left to let her return home."

Xue Yunping said, "Sister was abandoned by the Marquis of Wuding's estate. If the Xue family won't let her back into the manor, where is Second Sister supposed to go?"

"Commit suicide, or go become a nun in a Daoist temple or Buddhist nunnery. That would at least preserve the reputation of the Xue family's daughters."

Hearing her concubine mother's cold words, Xue Yunping couldn't help feeling a chill run down her spine. Because she accidentally fell into the water, she actually had only these two paths to take?

Concubine Hong smiled and said, "Xue Wanyao getting into trouble is actually a good thing. That Daoist priest said that to cure the eldest son of the Marquis of Wuding, we need to marry a daughter of the Xue family over there. Now that your second sister has met with misfortune, the person to become the eldest daughter-in-law of the Marquis of Wuding's estate will be you."

Listening to Concubine Hong's laughter, Xue Yunping's brow furrowed even more deeply.

---

The Prince of Chu's carriage traveled all the way to Qingyun Temple.

Qingyun Temple was the most famous Daoist temple in Shengjing City, and also the place where the Imperial Preceptor of the Great Sheng Dynasty practiced his cultivation.

Xue Wanyao lifted the carriage window curtain to look at the towering mountain ahead, then turned to the young girl beside her and asked, "Your Highness, what if the Imperial Preceptor discovers that the two of us have swapped bodies and decides to treat us as monsters to be eliminated? What should we do?"

Gu Zhuo, who was about to step out of the carriage, stopped in his tracks. He sat back down and looked at Xue Wanyao.

This matter was indeed too bizarre. Who could have imagined such an absurd thing as swapping bodies? What if the Imperial Preceptor really did treat the two of them as monsters?

Xue Wanyao said in a low voice, "Your Highness, don't you think we should wait and see how things develop?"

Gu Zhuo gave a light snort. "Wait and see? I think you purely want to usurp this Prince's body and refuse to return it to me! If that old Daoist dares to treat this Prince as a monster, I'll pluck out his beard!"

Xue Wanyao looked at what was clearly her own face, yet it displayed the proud, favored-child expression she had never possessed.

Gu Zhuo jumped down from the carriage and said, "Keep up."

Xue Wanyao got down from the carriage and looked at the mountain ahead. "Is this Daoist temple at the peak?"

Gu Zhuo nodded. "Mhm, have you never been here?"

Xue Wanyao shook her head. "Never."

Gu Zhuo said, "The peak isn't far. It takes about an hour to reach the temple at the top."

In the early morning, the mountain was wreathed in mist, with the occasional sound of birds singing.

Xue Wanyao gazed at the dimly visible summit, deeply afraid that she wouldn't be able to climb up.

Yet after climbing for about a quarter of an hour, she found herself not tired at all, not even panting, and full of energy.

When she looked back at Gu Zhuo, meaning her own body, he was panting heavily and climbing the mountain at a snail's pace.

Gu Zhuo walked up to Xue Wanyao, breathing heavily, "No, I can't go on. What kind of ghost body is this of yours? We've only been climbing for a quarter of an hour, and I can't climb anymore. You..."

Xue Wanyao said in a low voice, "I've never climbed a mountain before."

Gu Zhuo was truly exhausted to the limit. After climbing for another two quarters of an hour, he felt soreness all over his body, unable to lift his feet even an inch, and simply sat down flat on the mountain steps.

Xue Wanyao said anxiously, "Concubine Xue, this is against the rules. You can't sit like that."

Gu Zhuo collapsed and sat on the ground, saying, "I'm about to die, and you still care whether my sitting posture follows the rules? If I'm exhausted to death here, will that count as you dying or me dying?"

Xue Wanyao truly didn't know the answer to that, and could only say, "I hear the sound of a mountain spring. Would Your Highness like to go drink some water and rest for a moment before continuing up?"

Gu Zhuo no longer cared whether Xue Wanyao was touching his own body; he reached out his hand toward the youth. "Help me up!"

Seeing this, Xue Wanyao supported Gu Zhuo and led him over to the nearby mountain spring.

After drinking water and resting for quite a while, Gu Zhuo allowed Xue Wanyao to pull him toward the summit.

Having originally expected to reach the top in an hour, he ended up taking a full two hours to climb. When they reached the mountaintop temple, it happened to be mealtime. Gu Zhuo unceremoniously ate two bowls of porridge, and was about to have more when Xue Wanyao stopped him.

Xue Wanyao said softly, "Concubine Xue, eat a little less. Eating this much will make you gain weight."

Gu Zhuo couldn't care less at this point and drank yet another bowl of porridge.

Only after eating his fill and letting out a burp did he pull Xue Wanyao's hand again to go find Imperial Preceptor Yuantong.

They arrived at the main hall of the Daoist temple.

Upon seeing Xue Wanyao, Imperial Preceptor Yuantong bowed and said, "Immeasurable Heavenly Lord, greetings to the Junior Prince of Chu."

"It's Prince, not Junior Prince!"

Gu Zhuo's crisp female voice rang out from the side.

Xue Wanyao also bowed and said, "Daoist Priest, Concubine Xue and I have come to ask you about a matter."

Imperial Preceptor Yuantong's gaze shifted between the two of them. He lightly draped a horsetail whisk over his wrist, his voice mellow: "That the two of you should share such destiny; you should simply accept whatever comes your way."

Gu Zhuo frowned. "What accept whatever comes your way! This Prince refuses to be some weak woman! Imperial Preceptor, you must find a way to switch her and me back."

"Forgive me, Your Highness, but this poor Daoist is truly unable to swap the two of you back. This is the will of heaven; the will of heaven cannot be defied."

Gu Zhuo said, "Then does that mean I still have to walk down the mountain in this body?"

The female voice was filled with anger, a hint of grievance, and utter despair...

chapters.title: She Is This Prince's Concubine
chapters.content:
Unlike Gu Zhuo's utter despair, Xue Wanyao's heart was filled with extreme joy.

Going from a concubine meant to be confined to the inner courtyard to the most favored Junior Prince in Shengjing City, she could be said to have been reborn. How could she not be happy?

Gu Zhuo watched the youth before him break into a smile and glared angrily. "Try smiling again?"

Xue Wanyao gave a slight cough and asked, "Imperial Preceptor, do you know why the Junior Prince and I swapped bodies?"

Imperial Preceptor Yuantong replied, "This matter is too peculiar; this old Daoist also doesn't understand the reason behind it. The birth dates and hours of the two of you are identical, and yesterday's bolt of lightning in a clear sky was already unusual. Perhaps because of this, the two of you shared an affinity and swapped bodies."

Xue Wanyao asked again, "Then the next time it thunders, will the Junior Prince and I be able to switch back?"

"That's hard to say," Imperial Preceptor Yuantong made a Daoist hand gesture. "Everything depends on the will of heaven. Perhaps when the affinity arrives, each will return to their rightful place."

"Thank you, Daoist Priest, for resolving our doubts."

After Xue Wanyao politely bowed in gratitude to Imperial Preceptor Yuantong, she looked at Gu Zhuo and said, "Since the Imperial Preceptor cannot solve it either, let's head back first and wait to see how things develop."

Gu Zhuo took a deep breath. With no other methods available now, they indeed had no choice but to await the will of heaven.

As they descended the mountain, Gu Zhuo frowned at the winding mountain path.

They say going up the mountain is easy and coming down is hard, but Gu Zhuo felt that coming down was much more bearable than going up, at least not leaving him gasping for breath and unable to lift his legs.

Yet after taking a few more steps, he felt a sharp, agonizing pain in his knees and feet, which were trembling uncontrollably. Not a single part of his entire body felt comfortable.

"Xue Wanyao, what kind of broken body is this of yours..."

"Will this Prince really die on this mountain today?"

"No, no, I have to lie here for a while before walking again."

"They say doing good deeds brings good karma, why is it that when this Prince does good deeds, it's always returning kindness with enmity?"

Gu Zhuo grumbled all the way down, finally choosing to just lie down and refuse to walk further.

Xue Wanyao watched as Gu Zhuo used her body to sprawl across the path. She could only pray that no one walked by, otherwise Xue Wanyao's reputation would be completely ruined.

Just as Xue Wanyao's thought of relief crossed her mind, she heard the voices of two women approaching from afar.

You really do fear what you wish to avoid.

"Put that way, the Second Miss of the Xue family is also a tragic person. That Marquis of Wuding's estate and the Xue family are simply heartless! For the sake of so-called pristine reputation, aren't they just trying to drive the Second Miss of the Xue family to her death?"

"Exactly, Second Miss Xue has such a bitter life. Her in-laws despise her for falling into the water and being rescued by a strange man, and her maiden family also feels that because she was held by a strange man after falling into the water, she has lost the purity of a Xue family daughter, actually forcing her to commit suicide to preserve the Xue family's reputation. It is utterly venomous."

Hearing the voices drifting from afar, Xue Wanyao hurried over and pulled Gu Zhuo up. "Someone is coming."

Gu Zhuo had also heard the two familiar voices. He raised his eyes to look at Xue Wanyao and lowered his voice: "Your family actually forced you to commit suicide? It wasn't your fault you fell into the water; I merely rescued you and didn't ruin your purity at all. Why would you need to commit suicide to prove your innocence?"

Xue Wanyao sighed helplessly. "The Xue family rules are exceptionally strict."

Gu Zhuo said, "The ones coming up later are Du Rouzhi, the eldest daughter of the Duke of Ningguo's estate, and Princess Yuyue of the Prince Qin's estate. Don't show any cowardice; the fact that you and I swapped bodies must not be known to outsiders."

Xue Wanyao nodded lightly.

"Oh? Junior Prince?"

"Cousin!"

Xue Wanyao saw the two noble ladies approaching. The two of them were dressed in flamboyant red dresses, adorned with gorgeous jewelry, with fair and rosy complexions, smiling faces, looking radiant and magnificent.

Xue Wanyao nodded slightly. "Miss Du, Cousin."

Princess Yuyue walked up to Gu Zhuo, who was standing beside Xue Wanyao, and sized up the girl's delicate and pitiful appearance. "Cousin, when did you get such a beauty by your side?"

Gu Zhuo gave a light cough. "I'm Prince of Chu's maid."

Du Rouzhi had initially been on guard while looking at Gu Zhuo, but she relaxed upon hearing her claim to be a maid.

Seeing that Gu Zhuo was unwilling to admit she was his concubine, Xue Wanyao frowned slightly and placed a hand on the girl's shoulder. "Not a maid. This is my newly taken concubine, Concubine Xue."

Du Rouzhi frowned slightly. "Junior Prince, you actually took a concubine? How can you face Younger Sister A'yin?"

Gu Zhuo glared angrily at Xue Wanyao.

Xue Wanyao slowly lifted her hand from Gu Zhuo's shoulder and said in a low voice, "I have matters to attend to, so I'll head down the mountain first. Miss Du, Cousin, I take my leave."

After saying this, Xue Wanyao turned and left down the mountain first.

Gu Zhuo hurriedly chased after her.

Yuyue frowned. "Hmph, Cousin is acting rather strange today."

Du Rouzhi said, "Yuyue, could that girl really be Prince of Chu's concubine? She certainly has a vixen's face."

Yuyue smiled. "Even if she is a concubine, she can never surpass the position of Princess Consort Chu."

Xue Wanyao walked with her head down along the mountain trail. Gu Zhuo caught up to her and said, "From now on, you are not allowed to tell outsiders that Xue Wanyao is Prince of Chu's concubine."

Xue Wanyao looked at the girl before her. She truly did not want to switch back identities at all now. If she switched back, she wouldn't even have her identity as a concubine acknowledged.

In such a vast world, was there truly no place for her to find refuge?

"Did you not hear me speaking to you? Stop using this Prince's face to make such a aggrieved, effeminate expression!"

Xue Wanyao said in a low voice, "Is it because of Miss A'yin? Which family's daughter is Miss A'yin? Please enlighten me, Your Highness, so I won't accidentally be discourteous if I meet her and ruin Your Highness's marriage prospects."

Gu Zhuo frowned. "This has nothing to do with any Miss A'yin! This Prince simply doesn't want to take concubines, doesn't want to get close to women, or break monastic vows. Do you understand?"

"Oh."

Xue Wanyao replied softly.

The journey down the mountain was nothing short of torture for Gu Zhuo.

By the time they reached the foot of the mountain, his legs and feet were trembling violently.

Gu Zhuo had no choice but to ask Xue Wanyao to come and support him.

Xue Wanyao stood to the side and said, "You are not this Prince's concubine, only this Prince's maid. Why should this Prince support you?"

Gu Zhuo widened his eyes. "Xue, you dare to rebel?!"

Xue Wanyao said in a low voice, "You're the one surnamed Xue now."

The only thing Xue Wanyao could be glad of was that fate still treated her fairly well. If she truly had no place to stand and only a dead end ahead, whether committing suicide for reputation, becoming a nun to be bullied, or lowering herself to be his maid, she might as well make use of Gu Zhuo's identity to live a few days as a Junior Prince, relaxed, carefree, and happy. Even if she died afterward, it wouldn't be a waste of these few days of bliss.

"You return kindness with enmity!"

Gu Zhuo accused, "Xue Wanyao, you are truly a petty person."

Xue Wanyao said softly, "Although you saved my life, the path left before me is also a dead end. Either commit suicide to preserve my reputation, become a nun and suffer humiliation, or lower myself to be your maid."

"Better you hadn't saved me. Dying in the water would have spared me from this rootless suffering, and after drowning, I could at least have been buried in the ancestral tombs of the Marquis of Wuding's estate. Unlike now, where I don't even know where I'll be buried after I die..."

Gu Zhuo merely treated her as a maid, after all. When a maid died, it amounted to nothing more than being wrapped in a straw mat and buried in a pauper's grave.

chapters.title: Selecting the Princess Consort
chapters.content:
Gu Zhuo panted heavily with anger. "I saved your life, and somehow I saved it wrongly? It's bad enough that you show no gratitude, but you're actually blaming me?"

"You're facing a dead end right now not because I saved your life, but because the Wuding Marquis Residence and you Xue family members are utterly foolish. How on earth did I ruin your chastity?"

"Besides, even if your chastity were ruined, it shouldn't mean certain death. Staying alive is more important than anything else."

Xue Wanyao said in a low voice, "I know you didn't ruin my chastity, but in the eyes of the world, my chastity is ruined. I know life is important, but with the world this way, how do you expect me to barely survive?

Other than becoming your concubine, the only two paths left before me are, first, to kill myself. I haven't even reached my eighteenth year, and I don't want to die."

"As for the second path, it's to go to a Taoist temple and become a nun. But in a Taoist temple, you have to do all sorts of chores every day, scrubbing chamber pots for the seniors in the temple, living a life of extreme poverty in food and clothing. What's more, a Taoist temple for women might not necessarily be able to fend off the malicious intentions of villains..."

Gu Zhuo frowned and said, "If you have nowhere to go, wouldn't it be fine if I kept you as a maid?"

Xue Wanyao looked at the person in front of her. It was clearly her own face, but the expression was obviously Gu Zhuo's.

Xue Wanyao let out a dry laugh and said, "I may not come from a grand, prestigious family, but I am still the daughter of an official. My father's official rank may not be high, but he is at least an official in the Hanlin Academy. You want to make his daughter a slave and servant, and enter me into the slave registry?"

Gu Zhuo rubbed his nose and said, "That indeed doesn't seem quite right. Then I'll give you silver taels. You can use the silver to start some business, and when the time comes, find a good husband to marry. Why do you insist on becoming a concubine to me?"

With tears welling in her eyes, Xue Wanyao said, "I fell into the water and lost my chastity; this matter is probably known to the entire city of Shengjing. Which husband would not mind that I fell into the water and was rescued by an unrelated man? Right now, I have no other choice than to become a concubine to Your Highness."

Gu Zhuo looked at Xue Wanyao wearing his own face, looking on the verge of tears with pearls of moisture in her eyes. He furrowed his brows deeply and roared, "I told you, stop using my face to make such effeminate expressions!"

Startled by the roar, Xue Wanyao let a tear slip down her cheek.

For the first time, Gu Zhuo learned that his face could look so pitiable and heart-wrenching. Enduring the pain in his legs, he walked up to Xue Wanyao, reached out to wipe her tears, and said, "It's just the position of a concubine, I'll give it to you. You won't be left with nowhere to rely on, and when you die, you can be buried in our Gu family ancestral grave. Stop crying."

Xue Wanyao lowered her gaze to look into Gu Zhuo's eyes. "Your Highness, you are not allowed to go back on your word."

"I won't go back on it," Gu Zhuo said. "But you have to carry me down the mountain. I honestly can't take another step. How on earth did your body become this weak?"

Xue Wanyao said in a low voice, "The family rules for daughters of the Xue family are strict. We've always stayed inside the inner chambers and never stepped out. I have never walked such a long distance."

Gu Zhuo said, "Stop talking, hurry up and carry me on your back!"

Xue Wanyao whispered, "But... but didn't Your Highness say you would never touch me? How can I use your body to touch my body?"

Gu Zhuo: "..."

Seeing the young girl's foiled and bitter expression, Xue Wanyao let out a soft laugh, but she still bent down and carried Gu Zhuo on her back.

After all, the body Gu Zhuo was currently in was her own. If they happened to switch back tonight, she would probably be in excruciating pain.

Xue Wanyao was actually quite satisfied with Gu Zhuo's body. After climbing the mountain, it still felt like walking on flat ground, to think it could actually carry a woman on its back?

Xue Wanyao knew she wasn't a scrawny girl. Although her figure was well-proportioned, she was tall for a young woman, weighing around a hundred catties or so.

Using the young man's body to carry the young girl onto the carriage, Xue Wanyao didn't feel the slightest bit strained.

As soon as he reached the carriage, Gu Zhuo sprawled out and fell soundly asleep.

Looking at her own serene sleeping face, Xue Wanyao couldn't help but smile. She had finally obtained Gu Zhuo's permission to stay in the Prince of Chu Estate as a concubine, and she would even be buried in the Prince of Chu Estate's ancestral grave.

If she could also have a child to rely on in the future, that would be even better.

Xue Wanyao's face flushed slightly as she thought to herself: If she were to conceive a child right now...

Wouldn't that mean Gu Zhuo would be the one bearing the suffering of pregnancy for her?

Though Xue Wanyao had never been pregnant, even if she had never eaten pork, she had seen pigs run.

When her aunts and sisters-in-law at home were pregnant, they suffered from endless vomiting, and the screams when giving birth were especially terrifying.

Everyone said that a woman giving birth is the greatest pain in the world. If she could make Gu Zhuo endure the pain to give birth to a child while she happily became a mother, wouldn't that be a wonderfully good thing?

Xue Wanyao let her mind wander wildly all the way until the carriage finally arrived at the Prince of Chu Estate.

Xue Wanyao gently patted Gu Zhuo awake. With a hint of morning sleepiness, Gu Zhuo asked, "Why are you disturbing me?"

"Concine Xue, we have arrived at the Prince's Estate."

Gu Zhuo took a deep breath, jumped down from the carriage, and intended to return to Linfeng Courtyard to sleep soundly for a bit longer.

Who would have thought that the moment he stepped into Linfeng Courtyard, Gu Zhuo was greeted by four maids smeared with rouge and face powder. Gu Zhuo sneezed, furrowed his brows deeply, and said, "All of you, get out."

Azhen, the lead maid, curtsied and said, "Concubine Xue, His Highness the Prince sent us here to wait upon you..."

Gu Zhuo frowned. "I don't need maids to wait on me. All of you, get out."

Xue Wanyao, who had entered right behind Gu Zhuo, said, "Concubine Xue, you do need maids to wait on you. What are your names?"

Hearing the young Prince, who had always shunned female company, speak up, Azhen was quite surprised. She hurriedly bent her waist and replied, "Replying to Your Highness, this maid is named Azhen, sixteen this year. These are Azhu, Acui, and Alang. The three of them are all fourteen years old."

Xue Wanyao nodded and said, "This Prince understands. You all may stay and take good care of Concubine Xue."

Gu Zhuo got up from the couch and waved his hand to dismiss the four young maids. He stood up, raised his gaze to look at Xue Wanyao, and said, "I don't want to have maids around me."

Xue Wanyao said in a low voice, "But I need maids around me. You surely can't still have pageboys waiting on you when you bathe and use the chamber pot, can you?"

Gu Zhuo looked down at the women's ru-skirt he was wearing. It was indeed unsuitable, so he could only frown and silently default to letting the maids stay.

Lying down on the bed, Gu Zhuo said, "I'm going to sleep. You are not allowed to wander around aimlessly."

Xue Wanyao asked, "If I don't wander around aimlessly, may I go to your study and find a few books to read?"

"Fine."

Seeing that Gu Zhuo was resting, Xue Wanyao headed to the study. Just as she arrived and picked up a book, intending to read it, she saw the Grand Princess Changping enter the study.

"Mother." Xue Wanyao stood up and curtsied.

Looking at the gentle and polite young man before her, the Grand Princess Changping smiled faintly. "Ever since your consummation, you've truly grown up. This is how a Prince's composure should be, not like that little tyrant appearance you had in the past."

A trace of secret delight stirred in Xue Wanyao's heart. Even the Princess praised her for playing the role of the Prince better than Gu Zhuo did.

The Grand Princess Changping smiled and said, "Now that you've taken a concubine, it's also time to select a Princess Consort for Prince of Chu."

The candidate for the Princess Consort... Xue Wanyao didn't dare make decisions for Gu Zhuo.

"Mother, this child is still young, so there's no need to rush in choosing a Princess Consort."

"How can it not be rushed? The Gu family has been an only son for three generations, and now you are the only remaining seedling. You should marry early to spread branches and leave descendants for the Gu family."

chapters.title: Sleeping on the Same Bed
chapters.content:
The Grand Princess Changping smiled and said, "I see that you usually walk quite close to the Duke of Ningguo's estate and Yuyue and the others. You grew up as childhood sweethearts and know each other inside and out. Why not pick one of the two? Mother will help you sound them out."

Xue Wanyao certainly didn't dare to make promises on Gu Zhuo's behalf. Putting down the book, she said, "Mother, this child has not yet reached the age of capping. I'd like to study for a few more years and establish my career before settling down."

"To settle down and establish a career, settling down always comes first."

The Grand Princess Changping smiled and said, "With spring just around the corner, come the third day of the third month, the Flower-Appreciating Festival, I will host a flower-viewing banquet at the Princess's Manor. At that time, you can take a peek from hiding and tell your mother which young lady you fancy. Mother will help you propose marriage."

Since childhood, Xue Wanyao had never dared to disobey the wishes of her mother, Madam Xue. Towards the affectionate Grand Princess Changping before her, Xue Wanyao knew even less how to defy her.

"Then this child will listen to Mother."

The Grand Princess Changping said with gratification, "My son is truly sensible. Then I'll go take care of the matters concerning the Flower-Appreciating Festival banquet."

After the Grand Princess Changping finished speaking, Xue Wanyao stood up to see her off, saying, "Mother, walk slowly."

Looking at the child before her who was both courteous and yet carried a touch of detachment, Princess Changping felt immensely gratified. The child had finally grown up a lot.

After bowing to send off the Grand Princess Changping, Xue Wanyao began to read Gu Zhuo's books.

Confined to the inner chambers, Xue Wanyao could only read her elder brother's books to pass the time and relieve her boredom. Fearing she wouldn't understand, her brother would leave notes in the margins. Unfortunately, her wedding date had been set in a hurry, and her brother hadn't been able to make it back in time.

Had her own brother escorted her out in marriage and rescued her, she wouldn't have suffered the ruined reputation of lost chastity.

As Xue Wanyao was reading, she heard some commotion outside and stood up. She saw Gu Zhuo walking over with a head of hair as messy as a bird's nest.

Seeing this, Xue Wanyao couldn't help but smile. "Why didn't you comb your hair before coming out?"

"I don't know how to comb hair! My legs hurt so much they practically don't feel like my own. When on earth will lightning strike and switch the two of us back?"

With every step Gu Zhuo took, he felt a wave of soreness and pain.

Xue Wanyao walked up to Gu Zhuo and said, "I'll comb your hair for you."

After making Gu Zhuo sit down, Xue Wanyao used her fingers as a comb. Initially, she wanted to leave a strand of hair tied up, but then she remembered that she was now considered a married woman, so she coiled Gu Zhuo's hair into a matron's bun instead.

Without a shred of politeness, Gu Zhuo propped both legs up on the desk and called out, "Wang Quan, Wang Quan..."

Xue Wanyao removed Gu Zhuo's legs from the desk and frowned. "The study is a place of importance, how can you prop your feet up?"

Glaring angrily at Xue Wanyao, Gu Zhuo said, "You're using my body, so you don't feel any pain at all! Do you have any idea how sore and aching your legs are? I feel like chopping both of your feet off!"

So, Xue Wanyao squatted down and began massaging Gu Zhuo's legs.

When the pageboy Wang Quan entered, he saw Concubine Xue, who had just entered the manor yesterday, sitting broadly while his own Prince was actually squatting down to massage her legs...

This sight was beyond shocking!

"Y-Your Highness..."

Xue Wanyao said, "It's nothing. You all may leave."

Seeing the expression on his pageboy's face, Gu Zhuo also felt it was inappropriate for "Prince of Chu" to massage his legs. He glared fiercely at Wang Quan and said, "What you just saw, you are not allowed to spread outside!"

"Yes," Wang Quan acknowledged and hastily retreated from the study.

Xue Wanyao fetched a chair from the side, sat down, and continued to massage Gu Zhuo's legs.

Seeing Gu Zhuo's look of absolute enjoyment, Xue Wanyao thought to herself that she was essentially massaging her own legs anyway.

"Your Highness, the Grand Princess Changping was just here. She said she will host a flower-viewing banquet on the third day of the third month, widely inviting all the young ladies of Shengjing. When the time comes, you can pick a girl who catches your eye from a hidden spot to be your Princess Consort."

As Xue Wanyao spoke slowly, Gu Zhuo furrowed his brows and said, "Didn't you decline it for me? You agreed?"

"The Princess is your mother, how could I dare refuse?"

Gu Zhuo said, "Precisely because she's my mother, you could refuse! My mother has always doted on me. You've ruined me, hurry up and tell my mother that I don't want to select a Princess Consort!"

Xue Wanyao said in a low voice, "Your Highness, I don't dare."

Xue Wanyao had never known that one could defy the orders of one's parents.

Gu Zhuo scratched his head and said, "You don't dare? What if my mother really picks a Princess Consort for me? Let alone the fact that I'm still in your body right now, if I actually marry a Princess Consort, which of us is going to consummate the marriage?"

Xue Wanyao gave a light cough, her face turning red.

Gu Zhuo said, "On the third day of the third month, you just tell my mother that out of this whole courtyard of young ladies, you didn't take a fancy to a single one. Understand?"

"Yes, Your Highness."

After partaking in the evening meal, Xue Wanyao strolled around Linfeng Courtyard to digest her food. Having left the manor for two days, she almost wished those two days had just been a dream.

As the sky grew dark, Xue Wanyao returned to the main bedchamber.

Not seeing Gu Zhuo, she realized he had gone to bathe. Upon hearing the word "bathe," a flush blossomed across Xue Wanyao's face.

A sound came from the doorway, and Xue Wanyao looked up to see Gu Zhuo, his face redder than maple leaves. The young girl was wearing a pink inner garment and underskirt, and even the tips of her ears were burning hot.

Gu Zhuo walked over to the bed and buried himself deep inside the quilt.

Much like the ostriches Xue Wanyao had read about in the Records of a Hundred Birds, his entire head was buried beneath the silk quilt.

In the darkness, Gu Zhuo recalled what he had seen when he lowered his head at the edge of the bathing pool. He grabbed the quilt tightly, only poking his head out to breathe after a long while.

Seeing Gu Zhuo's appearance, Xue Wanyao let out a soft laugh.

Gu Zhuo glared angrily at Xue Wanyao. "You're still laughing? If you laugh again, I'll... I'll... I'll hit your face."

Biting her lower lip to suppress her smile, Xue Wanyao asked, "Your Highness... am I still sleeping on the small couch today?"

Gu Zhuo blurted out, "Otherwise? Do you still want to sleep on this Prince's bed? Keep dreaming!"

Xue Wanyao looked at the small couch in Gu Zhuo's room; it wasn't a proper resting place to begin with.

Though Xue Wanyao had a tall and slender figure for a woman, she could barely manage to squeeze onto it.

However, she was currently in Gu Zhuo's body, and Gu Zhuo was half a head taller than her. Sleeping on that small couch would undoubtedly be far too cramped.

"Your Highness, your stature is too tall, I'm afraid you won't be able to fit on the small couch!"

Lowering the gauze bed curtains, Gu Zhuo said, "If you don't fit, can't you curl up your body to sleep?"

With a helpless sigh, Xue Wanyao had no choice but to lie down on the hard, small couch once more.

In the dead of night, Gu Zhuo felt his hands and feet were so ice-cold that he couldn't fall asleep at all; his feet felt like lumps of frozen ice. "Xue Wanyao, are you still awake? Why are your feet so freezing cold when you sleep? Are these even feet? They're basically millennial black ice."

Coughing lightly, Xue Wanyao said, "Many women are like this. Even though it's already the second month, there's still a late spring chill, and the nights are colder than the depths of winter. Your Highness can just have a pageboy fill a warming pouch to warm your feet."

"A warming pouch?" Gu Zhuo said. "This Prince hasn't used that sort of thing since childhood; the manor probably doesn't even have one. Are there any other methods?"

Coughing lightly, Xue Wanyao suggested, "You could find a maid to sleep on the same bed with you. That way it'll be warm, and your hands and feet won't be freezing anymore."

Gu Zhuo frowned. "How can I find a woman to sleep on the same bed with me? Besides, what if that maid also has ice-cold hands and feet? If I'm going to find someone, it should be a pageboy."

"No!" Startled, Xue Wanyao bolted upright from the small couch.

"How about... how about I sleep on the same bed with Your Highness?"

chapters.title: What Kind of Blessing Is Having a Child?
chapters.content:
Gu Zhuo opened his eyes wide, the young woman's face full of bashfulness and wariness: "No! You are not allowed to touch me. I won't be freezing once I fall asleep."

Xue Wanyao looked through the light of the small oil lamp by the bed at the deeply embarrassed young woman inside the bed curtains, gave a light cough, and said, "Your Highness, since you already permitted me to be your concubine during the day, sleeping in the same bed can hardly be considered overstepping the boundaries..."

"And... and..."

Xue Wanyao coughed again, only finding the man's voice hoarse and mellow. "And the Grand Princess also said that the Gu family's lineage is of the utmost importance. Since your concubine wishes to relieve the Grand Princess's worries, you and I should sooner rather than later..."

"Sooner rather than later, consummate our marriage and produce an heir for the Gu family."

Xue Wanyao was, after all, a seventeen-year-old maiden. Speaking of such embarrassing matters, her voice grew lower and lower...

Gu Zhuo asked, "Produce an heir for the Gu family?"

Xue Wanyao nodded. "Right now, you and I have swapped bodies. If we have an heir to the Gu family, you will even get to experience the happiness of nurturing and bearing a child. You will be able to personally give birth to your own child; this is a blessing that not many men in this world have ever experienced."

Gu Zhuo scratched his head and said, "A blessing? What kind of blessing is having a child!"

"Let me warn you, you are not allowed to ruin my maiden purity! Not allowed!"

Gu Zhuo declared, "My maiden purity still has great uses."

Xue Wanyao raised her eyes to look at the young woman standing on the bed and asked, "What great use could maiden purity possibly have?"

Gu Zhuo motioned for Xue Wanyao to step closer. "I am learning martial arts with my master. Among them is a supreme divine art that can only be mastered by maintaining maiden purity. By the way, I haven't practiced today yet. I'll teach you, and you can practice by following my form."

Hearing that they were going to practice martial arts, Xue Wanyao grew interested.

Gu Zhuo got out of bed using the young woman's body. Even though her legs ached severely, she still tried to mimic the boxing stances. Yet, when she threw a punch, it was soft and completely devoid of force.

Gu Zhuo felt utterly helpless.

Xue Wanyao followed Gu Zhuo's lead and threw a punch.

Gu Zhuo stepped forward to correct Xue Wanyao's posture. Seeing that Xue Wanyao's punch was equally powerless, a deep sense of despair washed over Gu Zhuo: "I've practiced martial arts for five years. Surely it won't all go down the drain just like this?"

Xue Wanyao looked at Gu Zhuo with a trace of apology. "I'm sorry... I..."

Filled with despair, Gu Zhuo returned to the bed. "Say no more. Go back to your daybed."

Xue Wanyao lay back down on the small daybed. In truth, she harbored a sense of guilt. Gu Zhuo had saved her, yet she had forced him to provide her with a place of safety and a livelihood.

Now, the supreme art Gu Zhuo had spent five years practicing had been ruined because she had ended up inside his body.

Carrying this guilt, Xue Wanyao drifted off to sleep.

Not knowing how much time had passed, she heard some movement and slowly opened her eyes.

Outside, daylight had broken. Inside the room, the young woman was crouching in a horse stance and throwing punches, shouting "Hah! Ha!" with plenty of momentum.

Xue Wanyao looked at the young woman and said, "Good morning, Your Highness."

Ignoring Xue Wanyao, Gu Zhuo picked up the sword from the bed and began practicing with it drawn.

It was the first time Xue Wanyao had ever seen that when she wielded a sword, she looked so heroic and dashing.

With the sword in hand, Gu Zhuo executed a side aerial flip. Just as he landed, he heard a crisp crack, followed by a wave of intense pain. He had no choice but to steady himself against the edge of the bed to rest. "You're a seventeen-year-old girl, and a side aerial flip is enough to sprain your waist? Your physique is even worse than an eighty-year-old granny's."

"Do you not normally practice martial arts to strengthen your physique?"

Xue Wanyao said in a low voice, "A daughter of the Xue family considers propriety and ladylike demeanor her primary duty. For a young lady to go around fighting and killing... is improper."

Gu Zhuo used the scabbard to tap Xue Wanyao on the forehead. "Pedantic! What of it if she's a woman? Why can't a woman fight and kill? Do not speak such pedantic nonsense while wearing my face."

"Sigh! Who knows when we'll be able to switch back? If we can't switch back, I'll have to use your body to continue practicing the Yunying Art. I wonder if the Yunying Art can be practiced by a virgin maiden? You are still a maiden, right?"

Xue Wanyao blushed and nodded. "Yes."

Gu Zhuo got up and said, "Comb my hair."

Xue Wanyao walked over to Gu Zhuo and began combing his hair.

Early in the morning, after both had washed up, Gu Zhuo, disregarding the pain in his feet, dragged Xue Wanyao along to General Qin's estate.

Upon stepping out of the Prince's Estate, Gu Zhuo said to Xue Wanyao, "The person I'm taking you to see later is General Qin, who is also my master.
