His Yunying Art is exceptionally powerful; he can take on a hundred enemies on the battlefield. I need to go ask him if a virgin maiden can practice the Yunying Art."

Xue Wanyao said, "Since he is Your Highness's master, will your master be able to tell that I am not Your Highness?"

Gu Zhuo replied, "Such an absurd matter of swapping bodies, no one would believe it even if you told them. Just speak less later, and let me handle all the talking."

Xue Wanyao nodded slightly.

Arriving at the gates of General Qin's estate, Xue Wanyao watched as Gu Zhuo pulled her hand and swaggered into the courtyard. The pages and guards outside merely bowed and did not stop them.

As they walked past a covered corridor, Xue Wanyao saw a young man of about eighteen or nineteen emerge from behind a cypress tree and reach out to rest his hand on her shoulder.

The aura of the young man opposite her was too overbearing. Terrified, Xue Wanyao pushed him away, took two steps back, and frowned. "Please show some self-respect!"

Qin Lang chuckled. "Your Highness, why are you acting like a delicate young miss being flirted with?"

Xue Wanyao gave a light cough. "It's just that you suddenly jumping out like that gave me a fright."

Qin Lang looked at the young woman by Prince of Chu's side, noting that her appearance was exceptionally striking.

Gentle and composed, she resembled a white lotus emerging untainted from the muddy pond, pure, clean, and unblemished, while her demeanor carried a hint of aloof nobility.

"Your Highness, this younger sister by your side is..."

Xue Wanyao replied, "She is my newly taken concubine, the second young miss of the Xue family."

Qin Lang appraised the young woman's features, finding a sense of inexplicable familiarity: "The second young miss of the Xue family? Isn't she the bride of the Marquis of Wuding's eldest son who fell into the water the other day? How did she become Your Highness's concubine?"

Xue Wanyao said, "After she fell into the water, I went in to save her, saddling her with the ruined reputation of being touched by an outside man. I had no choice but to take her as a concubine to give her a safe haven and a livelihood."

Qin Lang turned to Xue Wanyao. "You've taken a concubine? Then have you ruined your maiden purity? Once that's ruined, you won't be able to practice my father's Yunying Art."

Finding it hard to put into words, Xue Wanyao simply shook her head in embarrassment.

Qin Lang let out a sigh of relief. "That's fine then. Otherwise, your five years of practice would have gone to waste."

Gu Zhuo pulled Xue Wanyao's hand and headed toward the courtyard where General Qin was located.

Upon entering, Xue Wanyao saw General Qin practicing his forms. She stepped forward and said, "Master."

General Qin smiled faintly. "Your Highness, this young lady by your side is..."

Gu Zhuo said, "General Qin, I am Prince of Chu's newly taken concubine from two days ago. I heard that Prince of Chu practices the Yunying Art under your guidance, and I wish to practice it as well. I wonder if a virgin maiden can practice the Yunying Art?"

General Qin looked at the young woman before him and smiled lightly. "The Yunying Art can be practiced by anyone; it doesn't require any sort of virgin body of purity."

Gu Zhuo looked at Xue Wanyao.

Xue Wanyao asked, "Then why did your esteemed son say that only a virgin body can master this divine art?"

Hearing this, General Qin gave a calm smile. "What I said before about needing a virgin body was just to trick my boy Lang, so that he wouldn't indulge in female beauty at a young age and neglect his martial arts practice. The Yunying Art can be practiced by anyone; there is no rule stating only a virgin body can learn it."

chapters.title: Expelled from the Xue Clan
chapters.content:
Xue Wanyao lowered her gaze to look at Gu Zhuo. Gu Zhuo simply smiled and said, "I understand now. Thank you, General, for clearing up my confusion."

General Qin asked Xue Wanyao, "So, Your Highness, the reason you were unwilling to speak of marriage over the past two years wasn't because of this, was it, just to preserve your maiden purity to practice the Yunying Art?"

Xue Wanyao nodded slightly. She figured that Gu Zhuo's reluctance to marry must have been for this very reason.

General Qin said, "Ah Lang really leads people astray; he almost ruined Your Highness's grand matter of posterity. Seeing that Your Highness is about to turn eighteen, it is indeed time to marry early, add to the Gu family's incense, and let the spirits of the late Prince and Princess rest in peace."

Xue Wanyao smiled calmly. "Master, rest assured, I will prioritize posterity and bear children for the Gu family soon. We shall take our leave now."

Watching Xue Wanyao wear his own face and smile so calmly, Gu Zhuo furrowed his brow slightly.

Once outside the gates of the Qin estate, Xue Wanyao looked down at Gu Zhuo. "Your Highness... you see, one doesn't need to be a virgin to practice the Yunying Art. Shall we consummate our marriage tonight and bear children for your Gu family?"

Xue Wanyao wasn't certain whether she and Gu Zhuo would ever be able to switch back.

Having a child now would be extremely advantageous for her. As for the hardship of pregnancy, the more days Gu Zhuo endured it, the fewer days of suffering she would have to bear.

The most ideal scenario would be to let Gu Zhuo walk through the gates of hell in her place and give birth to her own child.

Moreover, although a child born from her belly would also be considered a child of the Prince's Estate, when all is said and out, it would still be a concubine-born child. If it were a boy, it would be somewhat better; if it were a girl, whether her future dowry would be subsidized would entirely depend on Gu Zhuo.

Having personally experienced the agony of childbirth, he would surely feel some pity for the child.

Gu Zhuo raised a hand and lightly tapped Xue Wanyao on the head. "Weren't you quite pedantic earlier? Being rescued from the water made you feel that being touched by an outside man ruined your reputation. How is it that now you can talk about bearing children without a shred of shyness? Is this something a young maiden should be saying?"

Xue Wanyao touched her forehead and said, "Your Highness saved my life; naturally, I must bear a child for Your Highness early on to repay your great kindness."

Gu Zhuo raised his eyes and glared coldly at Xue Wanyao. "Say that again about who is bearing it? You're in such a hurry to spread branches and leaves for our Gu family, you're probably plotting to make me bear the hardship of childbirth for you, aren't you?"

Xue Wanyao gave a light cough. "No, I simply want Your Highness to taste the blessing of being a mother."

Gu Zhuo let out a light huff. "Little white-eyed wolf. Let's go, let's go to the ready-to-wear shop and buy a few outfits. The clothes your mother gave you all have large sleeves and long skirts, making them utterly inconvenient to wear. I'm going to buy a few lighter, more convenient sets."

Xue Wanyao looked at the young woman in front of her. "I actually thought they looked quite pretty."

She had never worn such luxurious fabrics before; the princess's garments featured exquisite embroidery, and those wide-sleeved, long-skirted dresses were things any young woman would adore.

"It's not you who has to wear such cumbersome clothes."

With that, Gu Zhuo irritably grabbed Xue Wanyao's wrist and pulled her toward the clothing shop.

Finding the shopkeeper, Gu Zhuo requested light and convenient garments. Without even trying them on, he gave a wave of his hand and took them all.

Hearing that these clothes cost nearly a thousand taels, Xue Wanyao couldn't help clicking her tongue in astonishment. Her own dowry had only been three thousand taels...

And right now, her dowry wasn't even in her own hands anymore...

The Xue family despised her for falling into the water and losing her reputation, yet when it came to the dowry that should have rightfully been hers, the Xue family didn't mind sharing that disreputable taint and had taken it all back.

After buying the clothes, Gu Zhuo led Xue Wanyao to a restaurant he frequented.

It was Xue Wanyao's first time dining at a restaurant. This establishment actually had two floors, and upstairs by the window was a canal, from which peddlers' cries drifted over from the streets on the opposite bank from time to time.

Seeing Xue Wanyao's amazed expression, Gu Zhuo asked, "Have you never come to Apricot Blossom Restaurant to eat before?"

Xue Wanyao shook her head slightly. "I've only heard of it."

A waiter walked over with a white towel slung over his shoulder. "Your Highness, will it be the same as usual today?"

Xue Wanyao nodded slightly. "Yes. I heard that your Apricot Blossom Restaurant's honey-roasted squab is exceptionally delicious. I'd like a serving of honey-roasted squab as well."

"Right away!"

After the waiter left, Gu Zhuo looked at Xue Wanyao. "It's rare that you even know about the honey-roasted squab."

"My fourth younger sister loves it. From time to time, she would beg father and our eldest brother to buy squab back for her to eat. I've smelled it, and the aroma is quite fragrant, though I've never tasted it."

"Didn't your fourth younger sister ever give you any to eat?"

Xue Wanyao merely smiled. "My fourth younger sister is rather protective of her food."

"If you wanted to eat it, why didn't you beg your father to buy you some?"

Xue Wanyao lowered her gaze. "I didn't dare."

Gu Zhuo said, "What is there not to dare? It's just a squab. Your father is truly biased; since he bought one for his fourth daughter, why wouldn't he buy one for his second daughter?"

The waiter served the dishes promptly, laying out the full spread in less than fifteen minutes.

Xue Wanyao finally tasted the roasted squab, her eyes curving into crescents as she said, "It really is delicious. No wonder fourth sister likes it."

While the two were dining, another table of guests arrived in the adjacent booth. Through the screen, Xue Wanyao heard the discussion drifting over from next door.

"I heard the Xue family has removed the bride who fell into the water the other day from the clan registry. Now, the former third young miss of the Xue family has become the second young miss, and in a few days, she'll be married off to the Marquis of Wuding's estate."

Hearing this sentence through the screen, the delicacy in Xue Wanyao's mouth instantly lost all flavor.

"How is it that a daughter of the Xue family is still marrying into the Marquis of Wuding's estate?"

"The Marquis's eldest son is gravely ill. Originally, matching him with an official of humble rank like the Xue family was purely to bring good luck through aa Chongxi marriage (to ward off bad luck). Otherwise, how could a daughter from such a minor official's household ever be worthy of the Marquis of Wuding's eldest son? Even if she were a concubine-born daughter, it wouldn't be the Xue family's turn..."

"That Miss Xue Wanyao is truly a tragic figure. She fell into the water and was pulled out by an outside man in full view of everyone, and now she's been disowned by her maiden family. Who knows how she'll survive from now on?"

"The truly pitiful one is the third young miss of the Xue family. Now that she's become the second young miss, she has to go perform the chongxi. They all say the Marquis's eldest son probably won't live much longer, going over there means becoming a widow."

Hearing the discussion from next door, Xue Wanyao felt as cold as ice, and her appetite vanished completely.

Seeing Xue Wanyao's expression, Gu Zhuo said, "Let's go."

Xue Wanyao took out silver from her purse, placed it on the table, and walked out of the restaurant with Gu Zhuo.

Walking into a deserted alleyway, Xue Wanyao leaned against the wall to steady herself, her voice hoarse: "And here I was wondering why Father and Mother would ever let good fortune fall upon me instead of fourth sister... So this so-called good marriage they spoke of was just a chongxi match...

So my prospective husband was already on the verge of death..."

"So in the Xue family, I could be cast aside and erased from the clan just like that..."

"I merely fell into the water, what grave mistake did I make? Why did even the clan registry have to purge me?"

Xue Wanyao couldn't hold back her tears. She should have known long ago that in the Xue family, she was merely a tool used for marriage alliances; the Xue family had never once cherished her as a daughter.

Gu Zhuo raised a hand to wipe away Xue Wanyao's tears, not knowing how to comfort her.

Just like when he used to cry as a child and his mother would hold him in her arms, he pulled Xue Wanyao into his embrace.

Xue Wanyao lowered her head and wept in the young woman's arms, her tears falling unceasingly.

Gu Zhuo gently patted Xue Wanyao's back in comfort.

Three young men passing by the mouth of the alley heard the weeping, glanced over once, and walked past.

"Is that the young prince?"

"Seems like it..."

The three young men uniformly took three steps back, only to see a pretty and tender young woman in the alleyway holding "Prince of Chu" in her embrace and softly soothing him...

While Prince of Chu was weeping like pear blossoms in the rain, looking utterly pitiful.

No matter how one looked at it, the scene was bizarre through and through.

chapters.title: Xue Wanyao is Unworthy to be the Prince of Chu's Consort
chapters.content:
When Gu Zhuo was holding and comforting Xue Wanyao, he sensed that someone seemed to be looking at them. Turning around, Gu Zhuo spotted his friends at the alley entrance, all three wearing identical expressions of shock.

"What are you looking at?"

Gu Zhuo frowned and spoke, only realizing how bizarre the scene looked the moment the words left his mouth.

In the eyes of the three men standing before him, didn't it look like Prince of Chu, Gu Zhuo, was crying while being consoled by a young maiden?

Gu Zhuo quickly released the youth in his arms.

"Cough, cough!"

Gu Zhuo cleared his throat heavily and offered a reluctant bow to the trio. "Greetings, Heir of Prince Qin, Heir of the Duke of Ningguo, Heir of Marquis Anwang."

Upon hearing Gu Zhuo address three different heirs in succession, Xue Wanyao raised her gaze to look. The three young gentlemen were all equally handsome, seemingly only around eighteen or nineteen years of age.

Xue Wanyao gave a light cough and offered a guilty, transparent explanation. "Something flew into my eye, so I had the Concubine Xue blow on it for me."

Zhao Ke, the Heir of Prince Qin standing at the front, asked in surprise, "Concubine Xue? You've taken a concubine?"

Xue Wanyao nodded. "A concubine taken the day before yesterday."

Zhao Ke smiled faintly. "My cousin-in-law is truly a beauty of jade and flowers."

Hearing this, Xue Wanyao realized that the speaker must indeed be the Heir of Prince Qin. With a smile, she said, "I hardly dare accept the Heir calling her sister-in-law; she is merely a concubine."

Hearing this, Gu Zhuo couldn't help but frown.

The Heir of Marquis Anwang said, "We are on our way to Apricot Blossom Tower for a meal. Would the little prince care to join us?"

"We've already eaten. Let's gather another day; we must be getting back."

Xue Wanyao didn't dare spend too long with these people. After all, she knew absolutely nothing about Gu Zhuo's life, and it would be far too easy to slip up.

After nodding in lieu of a bow, Xue Wanyao pulled Gu Zhuo by his slender wrist and walked toward the Prince of Chu's residence.

She completely disregarded the confusion and astonishment in the hearts of the three heirs.

Back in the bedchamber of the Prince of Chu's residence.

Gu Zhuo asked Xue Wanyao, "Just now, Zhao Ke called me cousin-in-law. Why did you say you didn't dare accept it?"

Xue Wanyao replied, "I truly didn't dare accept it. Concubine Xue is merely a concubine. Even if the title was spoken in jest, it wouldn't do. If it reached the ears of the future Princess of Chu, Concubine Xue would end up looking like someone who doesn't know her place."

Gu Zhuo frowned slightly. "It would be one thing if you and I could switch back. If we can't switch back, you're going to use my identity to marry a primary consort, leaving me as a concubine for the rest of my life?"

Xue Wanyao pressed her lips together lightly. "Xue Wanyao has already been struck from the Xue family clan registry, and I'm no longer even a daughter of the Xue family... Even less am I worthy of being the Prince of Chu's consort."

As those words left her mouth, Xue Wanyao felt a sour tightness in her throat.

Gu Zhuo declared, "No! If you and I cannot switch back, you must let me be the Prince of Chu's consort!"

Xue Wanyao looked at Gu Zhuo. "The position of the Prince of Chu's consort is not something Your Highness gets to decide."

"Why shouldn't my consort be decided by me?" Gu Zhuo retorted. "Before we switch back, you are not allowed to stir up any Princess of Chu nonsense for me outside!"

Xue Wanyao leaned in close to Gu Zhuo, whispering near the youth's slightly reddened ear, "Your Highness, you can conceive a child. That way, you can also become a secondary consort, at least you'll have some kind of backing."

Gu Zhuo pushed Xue Wanyao away. "You ungrateful wretch, why are you always thinking about getting me pregnant?"

Xue Wanyao explained, "I'm doing this for Your Highness's own good. As I said, it would be fine if we could switch back, but if we truly can't, you, a dignified Prince of Chu, surely can't remain a concubine for the rest of your life? Giving birth to a son early on would also allow you to become a secondary consort sooner..."

"Bah!" Gu Zhuo snapped. "Don't think I don't know what you're plotting. Dismiss the notion of making me bear a child for you as soon as possible.

In a couple of days, you'll be going to study at Minglu Academy. Let me brief you on the habits of my classmates first."

Xue Wanyao's eyes lit up. "Go study at Minglu Academy? I can go study at Minglu Academy?"

Minglu Academy was the finest academy in the entire capital of Shengjing, and its students were handpicked pillars of the imperial court.

Her full-blooded eldest brother had passed the academy's examinations back then, but the spot had been snatched away by her second brother.

This was solely because the second brother was born of the primary wife and had a more formidable maternal family, which would make his future official career smoother.

Since her eldest brother possessed such talent, perhaps he would be able to pass the entrance exams to Minglu Academy in three years.

Unfortunately, when her eldest brother took the entrance exam at the end of the year before last, he failed to pass and could only pursue his studies outside.

Gu Zhuo said, "How can you still look so happy about going to school?"

Xue Wanyao replied, "Naturally, I'm happy. I've never been to school, not even a private village school. It was my concubine-mother and wet nurse who taught me to read, and my eldest brother who let me read the books he had already memorized, or sometimes I would copy books out, and when my eldest brother had free time, he would teach me."

"You have an eldest brother?" Gu Zhuo frowned. "Then why didn't your eldest brother come to send you off to be married? With your brother around, why did I have to go down and save you?"

Xue Wanyao said, "Well, my eldest brother is only two years older than me and is studying away from home. My wedding date this time was set in such a rush that there was no way for my eldest brother to rush back and send me off in marriage... Actually, with the wedding date set with such urgency, I should have guessed that this marriage was meant for rushing away bad luck."

When Xue Wanyao turned fifteen, her concubine-mother began worrying about her marriage.

However, her mother, Madam Xue, was not the least bit anxious, saying that if her father, Xue Shen, could receive a promotion, her own prospects for marriage would improve as well.

This dragged on until she was seventeen, and her fourth sister had already turned fifteen.

As for the excellent marriage prospect with the eldest son of the Marquis of Wuding, if it weren't for the fact that whoever married him would be widowed shortly after, I'm afraid it wouldn't have fallen to her lot anyway.

Gu Zhuo remarked, "It's one thing for those parents of yours to marry a fine daughter off to be a widow, but to refuse to let you enter the house after you fell into the water, striking you from the Xue family registry now is actually a blessing. I certainly won't bow to them or call them mother and father. From now on, you've severed ties with the Xue family."

Xue Wanyao said, "My concubine-mother is still in the Xue family, and she has always been quite good to me. I imagine she must be extremely worried about me these past couple of days, but I don't know how to let her know that I'm doing well in the Prince's residence so she won't worry."

Gu Zhuo replied, "I have shadow guards. Entering your Xue family is like stepping into an empty courtyard. Just have a shadow guard go report a message to our mother."

Xue Wanyao looked at Gu Zhuo in surprise; he actually said "our mother"...

Xue Wanyao's curiosity about the shadow guard only grew. "A shadow guard?"

"Yes," Gu Zhuo said. "Just whistle three times and a shadow guard will appear. Give it a try."

"But I don't know how to whistle."

Xue Wanyao tried several times, but all that came out was a breathy hiss.

Gu Zhuo stepped forward to teach Xue Wanyao how to whistle. "Place your fingers here like this, and blow hard."

Fortunately, Xue Wanyao was clever and learned how to whistle after practicing for a bit. After blowing three times, a man dressed in black floating-cloud brocade stepped in from outside and dropped to one knee.

"Your Highness."

Xue Wanyao cleared her throat slightly and said, "Go to the residence of Xue Shen in the Hanlin Academy, find Lin Yiniang in the backyard, and tell her that Xue Wanyao is a concubine in the Prince's residence and is doing very well, so she needn't worry too much."

The shadow guard acknowledged the order. "Understood, Your Highness."

After the shadow guard left, Gu Zhuo comforted Xue Wanyao. "You don't need to worry about our mother anymore. The pressing matter now is that you are going to the academy and won't be able to bring me along. You'll have to deal with whatever comes your way by improvising...

"Ungrateful wretch, why don't you just feign illness and skip the academy? Without me by your side, you're bound to give yourself away once you get there."

Xue Wanyao shook her head lightly. "No, I want to go study at the academy."

chapters.title: Sharing a Bed
chapters.content:
Xue Wanyao's eyes shone brightly. "I never imagined I would one day have the chance to study in an academy. Now, I suppose heaven sees that I survived a great disaster and has granted me the fortune to study. I want to go."

Gu Zhuo looked at Xue Wanyao's expectant expression. They were clearly his own eyes, yet somehow they didn't seem quite like his anymore.

"Your Highness, I won't give myself away. You can rest assured."

Helpless, Gu Zhuo could only introduce her classmates. "There are a total of seven people studying with me. You've already met three of them: Heir of Prince Qin Zhao Ke, Heir of the Duke of Ningguo Du Feng, and Heir of Marquis Anwang Fan Yi. They are childhood friends who grew up with me.

"Besides those three, there are Yan You, son of the current Chancellor Yan; Li Ze, son of a Hanlin Academy academician; Zhou Hao, son of the Minister of Rites; and Gu Qing, son of the Grand Tutor."

Listening to Gu Zhuo outline the general appearances and habits of these individuals, Xue Wanyao felt a sense of familiarity take root in her mind, and she grew full of anticipation to meet them at the academy in a couple of days.

Gu Zhuo continued, "And our instructor is Xu Yan, the dean of Minglu Academy. He loves to test students on essays during class. If you can't answer, it'll be a terrible embarrassment for me. Besides, your handwriting and mine are different; you really shouldn't go to the academy. Just feign illness instead."

Filled with anticipation, Xue Wanyao was no longer willing to fake an illness. "I won't embarrass Your Highness. I beg Your Highness, let me go, Your Highness..."

Hearing Xue Wanyao use a pleading tone, Gu Zhuo repeatedly protested, "Stop using my face and my voice to act spoiled!"

"Then Your Highness is agreeing to let me go to Minglu Academy," Xue Wanyao said.

Unable to bear Xue Wanyao acting spoiled while wearing his face, Gu Zhuo said in a low voice, "You'd better not write any essays at the academy. If the instructor asks you to write one, come back to the Prince's residence and let me write it for you."

"Yes." Xue Wanyao smiled at Gu Zhuo. "Thank you, Your Highness."

---

Night fell, in a secluded corner of the Xue family courtyard.

A woman in her early thirties, dressed in a cyan ruqun, knelt before a Buddhist statue, turning prayer beads in her hands and murmuring incantations.

"Mother!"

The woman turned her head and, upon seeing the travel-worn son who had returned, felt her eyes redden. "Jiashu."

Xue Jiashu bowed to the woman. "Your son pays respects to mother."

Looking outside, the woman said, "You child are not a tenth as sensible as your sister. I've told you so many times that I am not your birth mother. Please don't call me that in the future; be careful of walls having ears."

Xue Jiashu replied, "Mother, in the past I called her mother for sixteen years, how did she treat me?

"Mother, your son now has a modest business outside. Once my career is established and I can stand on my own feet, I will take you and sister away to live elsewhere."

"Your sister..." Lin Yiniang's eyes reddened. "Jiashu, your sister..."

Seeing the redness in Lin Yiniang's eyes, Xue Jiashu asked, "What's wrong with sister?"

Lin Yiniang wept. "Your sister was betrothed to the eldest son of the Marquis of Wuding, and was supposed to be married the day before yesterday."

"Married the day before yesterday? Such a major event as sister getting married, why was no one notified?"

"And that eldest son of the Marquis of Wuding was on his deathbed and long out of time. How could sister marry him?"

Xue Jiashu frowned. "Marrying him meant a lifetime of widowhood."

Lin Yiniang sighed deeply. "No wonder; I was wondering why they would arrange such a good marriage for your sister... But in truth, if your sister had married to live as a widow, it would still have been better than her current whereabouts being unknown."

"How can sister's whereabouts be unknown?" Xue Jiashu asked.

Tearfully, Lin Yiniang explained, "The day before yesterday, when your sister was getting married, she accidentally fell into the river. No one rescued her until she was saved by a passing stranger. The Marquis of Wuding's estate claimed that because your sister was embraced by a stranger after falling into the water, she lost her pure reputation, and they called off the betrothal.

"Your mother also said that the Xue family has always been a scholarly family of integrity, and a daughter who marries after losing her reputation is not permitted to return to the family. She forced Yaoyao to either commit suicide to preserve her purity or become a nun in a temple.

"Yesterday, no news came of Yaoyao committing suicide to preserve her honor. Your father made the executive decision to banish Yaoyao from the Xue family clan registry. I've already sent people to search various nunnery temples and Taoist shrines, but there has been no word to this day."

Xue Jiashu clenched his fists tightly, handed over a handkerchief, and said, "Mother, don't cry. The fact that no news of sister's suicide has arrived is the best possible news. Your son will do everything in his power to find sister.

"Your son will go look for her right now."

Xue Jiashu picked up the lantern placed outside the door, intending to go out into the night to search for Xue Wanyao, when he saw a figure in black leap over the high wall and land inside.

Xue Jiashu frowned deeply. "Who is it?"

"I am a guard by the side of the Prince of Chu. I've come upon his orders to deliver a message to Lin Yiniang. I harbor no ill intent."

Stepping out from the Buddhist shrine, Lin Yiniang said, "Prince of Chu? I don't know any Prince of Chu."

"Lin Yiniang, the Prince sent me to convey a message: your daughter Xue Wanyao is now a concubine of the Prince of Chu. She is living quite well as a concubine in the Prince's residence, so Lin Yiniang need not worry about her."

Having delivered the message, the shadow guard vanished into the dark night.

Hearing the guard's report, Lin Yiniang let out a heavy sigh of relief, but tears fell anew. "Jiashu, it is I who have failed you two siblings. After all this twisting and turning, it ends with your sister becoming a prince's concubine. And among the princes at court, which one isn't old enough to be her father..."

Xue Jiashu said, "Mother, the Prince of Chu is the same age as sister and was born on the very same day. To this day he has no primary consort, so he's not much older at all. I've seen him; he is extremely handsome. I only wonder how sister came to be his concubine.

"Don't worry for now, Mother. At least sister is still alive and lacks for nothing in food and clothing. Over the next couple of days, I'll think of a way to see if I can enter the Prince's residence to visit sister and ask about what happened."

---

Back in the Prince of Chu's residence.

Lying down to sleep on the small couch, Xue Wanyao heard the shadow guard return to report that he had delivered the message to the Xue family, and at last, her mind was at ease.

As for Gu Zhuo, because his hands and feet were ice-cold as usual, he simply did some qigong exercises in the room to warm up.

Only after working out would his feet stop feeling like blocks of ice.

After exercising for quite a while without his feet feeling any warmer, Gu Zhuo looked over at Xue Wanyao, who was curled up into a ball on the small couch.

"Is that how you sleep? No wonder I felt like you were slouching and hunching your back today. If you sleep all curled up like that, how could you not slouch?

"Straighten your legs out when you sleep. For a daughter of a noble family, what kind of sleeping posture is that?"

Xue Wanyao took a deep breath. She lay flat and straightened her legs, only to find that her feet were hanging off the edge of the small couch.

Blinking, Xue Wanyao looked at Gu Zhuo. "If I sleep lying flat, my feet stick out over the edge. It's cold."

Gu Zhuo: "Get down. Sleep on the floor."

"No, the chill is too heavy!" Xue Wanyao said. "I'll get rheumatism in the future."

Gu Zhuo pointed at the bed. "Sleep on the bed!"

"Thank you, Your Highness."

Xue Wanyao agilely rose from the small couch and lay flat on the large bed.

The soft bedding was far more comfortable than the cramped small couch.

With a dip in the mattress beside her, Xue Wanyao saw that Gu Zhuo had finished his exercises and lain down right next to her. Even though it was her own body, sharing a bed still felt indescribably strange to Xue Wanyao.

Yet upon closer thought, Xue Wanyao was already a concubine of the Prince of Chu, so sharing a bed was surely entirely logical and proper.

Suddenly, Xue Wanyao felt a chill between her legs as Gu Zhuo placed his feet against her lower calves to warm them.

Clearly, the maiden's feet were ice-cold, yet Xue Wanyao felt her entire body growing hot.

"Y-Your Highness... Can you move your feet away?"

Using the maiden's cool, aloof voice, Gu Zhuo asked, "What's wrong? Weren't your own feet cold? Are you really unwilling to let them be warmed up?"

chapters.title: How Did I Become a Concubine of the Prince's Estate?
chapters.content:
Xue Wanyao only felt it getting hotter and hotter, but Gu Zhuo, who was beside her, placed the young girl's cold hands around his waist to warm them.

Xue Wanyao could not help but hold her breath: "Your Highness!"

Gu Zhuo did not feel wronged in the least: "Your hands and feet are so freezing cold, what's wrong with me using my own body to warm them up?"

Xue Wanyao turned her gaze to look at Gu Zhuo and said, "But... but... the day before yesterday you said you wouldn't touch me at all..."

Gu Zhuo reached out and wrapped his arms tightly around the young man's waist: "I haven't touched you, I'm touching myself! This waist is my own, and these legs are my own too!"

Xue Wanyao: "..."

Xue Wanyao felt as though the blood throughout her entire body was boiling. The fresh fragrance of the young girl drifted into the tip of her nose, and the tips of her ears grew even hotter and more flushed.

After Gu Zhuo's legs and feet had been warmed up, she fell soundly asleep.

Xue Wanyao looked at the young girl in her arms who was sleeping with the most atrocious posture. How could Gu Zhuo have the nerve to blame her for having a bad sleeping posture?

She had never sprawled out so brazenly, clinging to someone else like a vine while sleeping.

A sound sleep through the night.

The next morning, when Xue Wanyao woke up, she only felt that her arm was a bit numb. Lowering her head, she saw Gu Zhuo lying in her arms, using her arm as a pillow.

Xue Wanyao felt her body was exceptionally hot, and instinctively wanted to hold the young girl in her arms tighter to make herself feel a bit more comfortable.

When Gu Zhuo opened her eyes, the young girl's long eyelashes fluttered lightly.

Xue Wanyao asked softly in Gu Zhuo's ear, feeling quite shy: "Your Highness..."

Hearing Xue Wanyao's voice, which was as faint as a mosquito's buzzing, Gu Zhuo blushed.

"Never mind it! It'll be fine in a moment."

Xue Wanyao replied, "Oh."

Xue Wanyao called for the maidservants to come in and wait upon them as they washed and dressed.

When Azhen wanted to comb Gu Zhuo's hair, Gu Zhuo frowned and said, "All of you get out. I want His Highness to comb my hair."

After waiting for the maidservants to exit, Xue Wanyao proceeded to comb Gu Zhuo's hair into a married woman's bun, feeling immensely satisfied with her handiwork.

Fearing that Xue Wanyao would give herself away at the academy, Gu Zhuo intended to take advantage of the academy's ongoing break today to have Xue Wanyao write a few characters for her to inspect.

Xue Wanyao walked over to the desk. When she picked up the brush to write, she felt that it was much easier than when she usually wrote.

Seeing the characters she wrote, Gu Zhuo remarked, "I wouldn't have thought that you look so frail and delicate, yet the characters you write are quite bold and magnificent."

"I learned this from my elder brother. My brother's handwriting is exceptionally good," Xue Wanyao said with a light smile. "My handwriting is entirely modeled after my brother's."

Seeing Xue Wanyao praising her elder brother, Gu Zhuo felt a slight twinge of jealousy and said, "Since your brother is so wonderful, how is it that he didn't come to save you when you fell into the water?"

Xue Wanyao replied, "My brother had no idea I was about to be married off. If he had known, he certainly would have seen me off, and I wouldn't have ended up reduced to a concubine."

Gu Zhuo said no more. She picked up the copy of Spring and Autumn Annals that the teacher had previously taught and began instructing Xue Wanyao.

Xue Wanyao said, "Your Highness, you're at such an age and still studying the Spring and Autumn Annals? I had already finished studying it when I was six years old."

"When you were six, you only understood the superficialities. What you study now is profound. I will teach you through it once first; that way, if Teacher Xu asks any questions, you won't be unable to answer and disgrace me!"

Xue Wanyao gave a soft smile and said, "Very well. But since you already know it all, why did you insist on going to study at the academy before?"

Gu Zhuo replied, "I'm only seventeen. My uncle cannot directly appoint me as a high-ranking official in the court, and I look down upon those empty, titular positions held by imperial relatives. I can only waste time at the academy, waiting until I reach the age of twenty or get married, and then I'll beg my uncle to appoint me as a great official!"

"You're already a prince, and you still want to be a great official?"

Gu Zhuo said, "Being a prince is just a title with no real power, just a fiefdom. Actually, I wanted to go to my fiefdom to become a vassal king, but my mother wouldn't allow it."

Xue Wanyao raised her gaze to look at Gu Zhuo: "Your Highness, you are already a prince. If you were to also become a powerful high-ranking official in the court, wouldn't His Majesty be wary of you?"

Gu Zhuo flicked Xue Wanyao on the forehead: "Stop trying to sow discord between my uncle and me."

Xue Wanyao let out an "oh" and continued to listen attentively to Gu Zhuo's instruction.

"Your Highness, Your Highness..."

Xue Wanyao heard the voice of the pageboy, Wang Quan, from outside the room.

"Enter."

Wang Quan entered, bowed, and said, "Your Highness, Young Master Li Ze is here to pay a visit."

"Li Ze?" Gu Zhuo frowned. "What is he coming to see me for?"

Xue Wanyao stood up and said, "I will go and see him. You go relay the message for him to wait a moment in the main hall and have a cup of tea."

Wang Quan acknowledged the order: "Yes."

Gu Zhuo said, "Although this Li Ze was my classmate, we haven't exchanged more than a few words. Why would he come looking for me?"

Xue Wanyao gave a faint smile and said, "There's no harm in going to see."

Gu Zhuo said, "I'll go with you."

Xue Wanyao walked ahead to the reception hall of the prince's estate.

Upon entering, the moment Xue Wanyao saw the person standing behind Li Ze, her eyes turned red, and all the grievances of these past few days welled up in her heart.

However, Xue Wanyao managed to force down her emotions. She paused her footsteps, lowered her head, and whispered to Gu Zhuo who was walking beside her: "The person standing behind Young Master Li is my own biological elder brother."

Gu Zhuo raised her eyes to look at the man standing behind Li Ze; he had an upright posture and the elegance of a jade tree in the wind.

Hearing the commotion at the entrance, Li Ze hurriedly stood up and saluted: "Your Highness."

Xue Jiashu, who was behind Li Ze, also saluted along with him, though his eyes were fixed entirely on his own younger sister. Having not seen her for a mere month, his sister seemed to have changed a great deal.

Xue Wanyao looked towards her eldest brother, and seeing that her brother's gaze kept drifting toward Gu Zhuo, she could only say in a deep voice, "No need for formalities. Please, all of you take a seat. Brother Li Ze, what brings you to see me today?"

Li Ze glanced at Xue Jiashu and said, "To not hide it from Your Highness, the reason for this rash and intrusive visit today is that my good friend Xue Jiashu wishes to see his younger sister..."

Gu Zhuo turned to Xue Wanyao and said, "Your Highness, Xue Jiashu is my eldest brother-in-law."

Xue Wanyao said, "Ah, so it is the eldest brother of Concubine Xue."

Hearing the words "Concubine Xue," Xue Jiashu's expression instantly tightened. "Your Highness, might you allow me to have a private word with Concubine Xue?"

Xue Wanyao naturally longed to speak privately with her brother, but right now she was not in her own body. If only she could switch back, once she switched back to her own body, she would be able to talk freely with her brother...

At this moment, she desperately wanted to return to her own body.

The very moment this thought arose in Xue Wanyao's mind, she felt a wave of pain in her head, accompanied by an aching soreness between her legs. What entered her field of vision was Gu Zhuo sitting right there...

Xue Wanyao closed her eyes, and when she opened them again, she saw Gu Zhuo right before her. She then lowered her head to look at her attire, had she really switched back?

Just like that, she had switched back so quickly? Doesn't that mean she wouldn't be able to go to the academy anymore?

Gu Zhuo felt that her head no longer hurt and her body felt much lighter and more nimble. She wiggled her fingers and smiled, "I'm back?"

"Your Highness?" Xue Jiashu's gaze shifted to Gu Zhuo. "I beg Your Highness to show mercy and permit me to speak with Concubine Xue alone for a few moments."

"Granted, granted!"

Being able to return to her own body naturally made Gu Zhuo extremely delighted.

For a moment, Xue Wanyao did not know whether to be happy or sad. The sorrow was that she ultimately failed to make it to the academy, and her biggest regret was not letting Gu Zhuo fully enjoy the blessing of pregnancy.

The joy was that she could still have a proper conversation with her elder brother.

Xue Wanyao led Xue Jiashu to a pavilion in the garden of the prince's estate. At this moment, the white magnolias were blooming in full splendor, and several magnolia petals had fallen onto the ground. Xue Wanyao picked one up and gently blew the dust off it.

Xue Jiashu spoke up: "Sister, how on earth did you end up becoming a concubine in the prince's estate?"

chapters.title: Leaving the Prince's Estate
chapters.content:
After Xue Wanyao sat down on the stone stool, she slowly began to speak: "On the day of my wedding, I fell into the river, and the Junior Prince of Chu rescued me from the water. The Wuding Marquis Residence despised me for losing my reputation, and the Xue family also disdained my laughable loss of purity. I was unwilling to commit suicide to prove my innocence, nor did I want to go to a Taoist temple to subsist on coarse grain and wild herbs, so I could only beg the prince to take me in."

Xue Jiashu furrowed his brows slightly: "It is your brother who has failed you. Had I known it would come to this, I should never have left Shengjing. Now it has led to you suffering such grievances and becoming a concubine."

Xue Wanyao gave a faint smile: "Being a concubine is not entirely unacceptable. Her Royal Highness the Grand Princess has promised me that as long as I give birth to a child, she will petition the Emperor to elevate me to a secondary consort."

Xue Jiashu let out a soft sigh: "If I had known, I should have returned a few days earlier. I am now doing business in another region, and my enterprise has achieved moderate success. With the help of Brother Li, given time I am bound to succeed. Even after you fell into the water, I could have taken you out of Shengjing and brought you with me to Qizhou."

"After all, a secondary consort is still a concubine in the end. If the primary princess consort above you is generous and virtuous, life for you and your child will be a bit easier; but if she is like, well, never mind. Now that you have already become the prince's concubine, saying anything more is of no use."

Xue Jiashu took out a stack of silver banknotes from his robes and handed them to Xue Wanyao: "Take these five thousand taels of silver; you can use them to manage affairs and grease palms within the prince's estate."

Xue Wanyao could not help but be utterly shocked at the sight of the five thousand taels of banknotes. "Five thousand taels? Elder brother, where on earth did you get five thousand taels? I cannot accept so much silver from you. I don't lack for food and clothing in the prince's estate anyway."

Xue Jiashu smiled and said: "Take it since I'm giving it to you. Your brother still has plenty of silver on hand. Didn't I tell you I'm doing business? These five thousand taels are not all that much."

Xue Wanyao was slightly stunned: "Eldest brother, aren't you studying abroad? How did you end up doing business instead? You are, after all, the eldest son of the Xue family, having spent ten years in bitter study. Your essays are written so brilliantly, how can you go into commerce? Families in commerce cannot take the imperial examinations for three generations..."

Xue Jiashu said: "There's nothing wrong with becoming a merchant. At the very least, one's food, clothing, and daily expenses can be exceptionally comfortable. With Brother Li and others backing me up, doing business isn't something where one easily gets bullied."

Xue Wanyao bit her lower lip tightly: "Brother, you were supposed to study for the imperial examinations and enter the imperial court as an official, rather than being reduced to a merchant now."

Seeing Xue Wanyao's face full of grievance, Xue Jiashu forced a light smile and said: "Doing business is also exceptionally good. You won't have to feel constrained by money in the prince's estate, and your purse can be a bit more loose. Once my business becomes a bit more stable, I'll find an opportunity to bring our mother to Qizhou..."

"I'm going too!" Xue Wanyao said. "Elder brother, I'm going to Qizhou as well."

Compared to being a concubine, Xue Wanyao desired even more to leave the Prince of Chu's Estate and go to Qizhou.

Even if she could never marry in this lifetime, as long as she had silver, she could live a good life of her own.

Xue Jiashu said: "But you are already a concubine of the prince's estate. Can you just leave?"

Xue Wanyao said in a low voice: "I can. The prince and I have not yet consummated the marriage, and moreover, the Junior Prince never wanted to take a concubine in the first place. He even felt that my offering myself to him as a concubine was returning kindness with enmity. Previously, I didn't know you were doing business outside, thinking only that you were studying, and I didn't dare to bring you trouble. Since you are already in business, I might as well follow you to Qizhou and live a carefree, wealthy life. Even if marriage proves difficult in the future, fortunately, I will at least have commerce to establish myself and make a living."

Xue Jiashu said: "That Junior Prince must be blind. My sister is so wonderful, yet he actually said your offering yourself to him was returning kindness with enmity! However, it couldn't be better if you can come with me to Qizhou."

Xue Wanyao gave a faint smile: "I will go bid farewell to the prince right now. Brother, please wait for me by the entrance of the estate for a moment."

"Alright."

After Xue Wanyao and Xue Jiashu returned to the reception hall, Li Ze stood up to take his leave of Gu Zhuo.

Watching Xue Jiashu and Li Ze depart, Xue Wanyao walked over to Gu Zhuo, knelt down, and said, "Many thanks to Your Highness for your care towards this humble concubine over these past few days, and also thank Your Highness for the grace of saving my life and taking me in."

"Rise, there's no need for such grand formalities."

Gu Zhuo raised her hand and looked at her own wrist: "I thought we would have to wait for the next clap of thunder before the two of us could switch back. Never did I imagine we would switch back so quickly. I suppose good people really do get rewarded."

Xue Wanyao stood up with a smile: "Your Highness, the reason I previously offered myself to you was because I had only a dead end before me and had no choice but to become your concubine. I am eternally grateful that Your Highness could tolerate my returning kindness with enmity, and for your immense kindness and virtue. Now that my brother has built up an enterprise in Qizhou, following him there does not necessarily mean a dead end."

"Your Highness, I shall no longer return kindness with enmity, nor will I make it difficult for Your Highness by forcing you to take a concubine. I shall leave the prince's estate right this instant and follow my brother to Qizhou..."

With that, Xue Wanyao bowed deeply to Gu Zhuo and made to leave.

Gu Zhuo looked at Xue Wanyao's bright smile and said, "Who gave you permission to leave?"

Xue Wanyao said, "Your Highness, don't you dislike me?"

Gu Zhuo replied, "This Prince does indeed dislike you, but what if you and I swap bodies again later? At that time, you'll be in Qizhou and I'll be in Shengjing City, separated by a great distance. If your secret leaks out or mine leaks out, won't we both end up being treated as demonic monsters and executed?"

The smile on Xue Wanyao's face faltered. "Your Highness thinks of everything."

Gu Zhuo said: "Just stay in the prince's estate until the next sound of thunder. If you and I do not swap bodies again, it will mean we can safely stay out of each other's way in the future. It won't be too late for you to leave the estate for Qizhou then."

Xue Wanyao thought about it, and what Gu Zhuo said was not without reason.

If she followed her brother to Qizhou and the two of them swapped bodies again, the journey back and forth would take four or five days.

Upon seeing a younger sister whose personality had completely changed overnight, her brother would naturally grow suspicious, and she herself would be completely in the dark regarding everything Gu Zhuo was dealing with in the estate.

Xue Wanyao said: "Then I'll go outside and tell my brother that I am temporarily not going to Qizhou with him."

Gu Zhuo let out an "en" and said, "Go on."

Xue Wanyao lifted the hem of her skirt, wanting to walk out quickly, but after taking just two steps, a soreness surged through her legs, forcing her to slow her pace.

Behind her, Gu Zhuo chuckled softly: "It's only right that you taste the suffering your own body brings. These past few days, this Prince hasn't had a single moment of comfort anywhere."

Hearing Gu Zhuo's gloating words, Xue Wanyao thought to herself that they had switched back far too quickly; she hadn't even fully enjoyed the thrill of being a prince, nor had she ever gone to study at the academy...

And her legs and feet were still aching from climbing that mountain earlier...

If only she could have been Gu Zhuo for a few more days, thoroughly relishing the thrill of being a prince, that would have been simply wonderful...

As Xue Wanyao thought this, her footsteps suddenly halted. She found herself sitting down at some point, holding a cup of warm tea in her hands.

Xue Wanyao raised her gaze and looked ahead: a young girl in a blue dress was just about to step out of the hall. With her slender silhouette, wasn't that none other than herself?

The young girl turned her head back, and with a refined yet exasperated voice, she cried out in utter frustration: "Are you toying with me? Heavens, you simply don't play fair!"

"How can the heavens be so blind!"

"No good deed goes unpunished, how on earth can my life as Gu Zhuo be this miserable!"

Xue Wanyao coughed lightly. Sure enough, the voice she emitted was that of a young man. She looked at the young girl complaining to the heavens in front of her, cleared her throat, and said: "Your Highness, my brother is still waiting outside. Might I trouble Your Highness to accompany me outside to have a word with him... I'm not going to Qizhou after all."
